sentences.zh: 二十八舍東方：角二星，為天闕，其間天門也，其內天庭也。

translations.literal: Of the twenty-eight lodges in the East: the two stars of Horn form the Celestial Gate-tower; between them is the Heavenly Gate, and within is the Celestial Court.
translations.idiomatic: In the eastern quarter of the twenty-eight lodges, Horn's two stars form the Celestial Gate-tower—the Heavenly Gate lies between them, and the Celestial Court within.

sentences.zh: 故黃道經其中，七曜之所行也。

translations.literal: Therefore the Yellow Path passes through their midst—the path of the seven luminaries.
translations.idiomatic: The ecliptic runs through them, marking the course of the seven luminaries.

sentences.zh: 左角為天田，為理，主刑，其南為太陽道。

translations.literal: The left Horn is the Celestial Field and the office of judgment, governing punishment; south of it is the Solar Path.
translations.idiomatic: The left Horn is the Celestial Field and seat of justice, governing punishment; the Solar Path lies to its south.

sentences.zh: 右角為將，主兵，其北為太陰道。

translations.literal: The right Horn is the General, governing armies; north of it is the Lunar Path.
translations.idiomatic: The right Horn is the General, governing warfare; the Lunar Path lies to its north.

sentences.zh: 蓋天之三門，猶房之四表。

translations.literal: They are the three gates of Heaven, like the four outer markers of Chamber.
translations.idiomatic: They are Heaven's three gates, as Chamber has its four outer markers.

sentences.zh: 其星明大，王道太平，賢者在朝。

translations.literal: When their stars are bright and large, the royal Way is at peace and worthy men hold office.
translations.idiomatic: When these stars shine bright and large, the royal Way is tranquil and the worthy serve at court.

sentences.zh: 動搖移徙，王者行。

translations.literal: If they tremble and shift, the king goes on campaign.
translations.idiomatic: When they quiver and move, the sovereign takes the field.

sentences.zh: 亢四星，天子之內朝也。

translations.literal: Neck has four stars—the Son of Heaven's inner court.
translations.idiomatic: Neck's four stars form the Son of Heaven's inner court.

sentences.zh: 總攝天下奏事，聽訟理獄錄功者也。

translations.literal: It oversees all memorials under Heaven, hears lawsuits, adjudicates cases, and records merit.
translations.idiomatic: It receives memorials from the realm, hears lawsuits, judges cases, and records achievements.

sentences.zh: 一曰疏廟，主疾疫。

translations.literal: It is also called the Dispersal Temple and governs pestilence.
translations.idiomatic: Also called the Dispersal Temple, it governs epidemic disease.

sentences.zh: 星明大，輔納忠，天下寧，人無疾疫。

translations.literal: When the stars are bright and large, ministers offer loyal counsel, the realm is at peace, and the people suffer no pestilence.
translations.idiomatic: Bright, large stars mean loyal ministers, a peaceful realm, and freedom from plague.

sentences.zh: 動則多疾。

translations.literal: If they move, pestilence will be widespread.
translations.idiomatic: Movement foretells widespread disease.

sentences.zh: 氐四星，王者之宿宮，后妃之府，休解之房。

translations.literal: Root has four stars—the king's lodging palace, the consorts' residence, and the chamber of rest and release.
translations.idiomatic: Root's four stars are the king's lodging, the consorts' quarters, and the chamber of repose.

sentences.zh: 前二星適也，後二星妾也。

translations.literal: The first two stars are the principal wife; the last two are concubines.
translations.idiomatic: The front pair represents the principal wife; the rear pair, concubines.

sentences.zh: 將有徭役之事，氐先動。

translations.literal: When corvée labor is imminent, Root moves first.
translations.idiomatic: When forced labor is at hand, Root stirs first.

sentences.zh: 星明大則臣奉度，人無勞。

translations.literal: If the stars are bright and large, ministers observe the law and the people know no toil.
translations.idiomatic: Bright, large stars mean ministers uphold the law and the people are not overworked.

sentences.zh: 房四星為明堂，天子布政之宮也，亦四輔也。

translations.literal: Chamber's four stars are the Bright Hall—the palace where the Son of Heaven dispenses government—and also the Four Assistants.
translations.idiomatic: Chamber's four stars form the Bright Hall, where the Son of Heaven governs, and also represent the Four Assistants.

sentences.zh: 下第一星，上將也；

translations.literal: The lowest star is the Chief General;
translations.idiomatic: The lowest star is the Chief General;

sentences.zh: 次，次將也；

translations.literal: the next, the Second General;
translations.idiomatic: the next is the Second General;

sentences.zh: 次，次相也；

translations.literal: the next, the Second Chancellor;
translations.idiomatic: the next is the Second Chancellor;

sentences.zh: 上星，上相也。

translations.literal: the upper star is the Chief Chancellor.
translations.idiomatic: the uppermost star is the Chief Chancellor.

sentences.zh: 南二星君位，北二星夫人位。

translations.literal: The two southern stars are the sovereign's seat; the two northern stars are the consort's seat.
translations.idiomatic: The southern pair marks the sovereign's place; the northern pair, the consort's.

sentences.zh: 又為四表，中間為天衢之大道，為天闕，黃道之所經也。

translations.literal: They also serve as the four outer markers; between them is the great road of the Celestial Crossroads, the Celestial Gate-tower, and the path the Yellow Path follows.
translations.idiomatic: They also form the four outer markers; between them runs the Celestial Crossroads—the Celestial Gate-tower where the ecliptic passes.

sentences.zh: 南間曰陽環，其南曰太陽。

translations.literal: The southern gap is called the Solar Ring; south of it is the Great Yang.
translations.idiomatic: The southern interval is the Solar Ring; beyond it lies Great Yang.

sentences.zh: 北間曰陰間，其北曰太陰。

translations.literal: The northern gap is called the Lunar Interval; north of it is Great Yin.
translations.idiomatic: The northern interval is the Lunar Gap; beyond it lies Great Yin.

sentences.zh: 七曜由乎天衢，則天下平和。

translations.literal: When the seven luminaries travel by the Celestial Crossroads, the realm is at peace.
translations.idiomatic: If the seven luminaries pass through the Celestial Crossroads, the realm enjoys peace.

sentences.zh: 由陽道則主旱喪，由陰道則主水兵。

translations.literal: If they take the solar path, drought and mourning prevail; if the lunar path, flood and war.
translations.idiomatic: The solar path brings drought and mourning; the lunar path, flood and war.

sentences.zh: 亦曰天駟，為天馬，主車駕。

translations.literal: It is also called the Celestial Team of Four and the Heavenly Horses, governing the royal carriage.
translations.idiomatic: Also called the Celestial Team of Four and the Heavenly Horses, it governs the imperial chariot.

sentences.zh: 南星曰左驂，次左服，次右服，次右驂。

translations.literal: The southern star is the Left Outrigger; next the Left Shaft-horse; next the Right Shaft-horse; next the Right Outrigger.
translations.idiomatic: From south to north: Left Outrigger, Left Shaft-horse, Right Shaft-horse, Right Outrigger.

sentences.zh: 亦曰天廄，又主開閉，為畜藏之所由也。

translations.literal: It is also called the Celestial Stable and governs opening and closing—the source of livestock stores.
translations.idiomatic: Also the Celestial Stable, it governs gates and stores—the source of livestock reserves.

sentences.zh: 房星明則王者明。

translations.literal: When Chamber's stars are bright, the king is enlightened.
translations.idiomatic: Bright Chamber stars mean an enlightened sovereign.

sentences.zh: 驂星大則兵起，星離則人流。

translations.literal: If the outrigger stars grow large, armies rise; if the stars scatter, the people disperse.
translations.idiomatic: Large outrigger stars herald war; scattered stars, mass migration.

sentences.zh: 又北二小星曰鉤鈐，房之鈐鍵，天之管籥，主閉藏，鍵天心也。

translations.literal: Two small stars north of Chamber are called Hook and Lock—Chamber's bolt and key, Heaven's pipes and valves, governing closure and storage, locking the Heart of Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: Two small stars north of Chamber are Hook and Lock—Chamber's bolt, Heaven's valve, governing sealed stores and locking the Heart of Heaven.

sentences.zh: 王者孝則鉤鈐明。

translations.literal: When the king is filial, Hook and Lock are bright.
translations.idiomatic: Filial kings make Hook and Lock shine bright.

sentences.zh: 近房，天下同心，遠則天下不和，王者絕後。

translations.literal: If they lie close to Chamber, the realm is united; if far, the realm is divided and the king's line ends.
translations.idiomatic: Near Chamber, the realm stands united; far from it, the realm splits and the royal line fails.

sentences.zh: 房鉤鈐間有星及疏圻，則地動河清。

translations.literal: If stars appear between Chamber and Hook and Lock, or if they scatter, the earth quakes and the rivers run clear.
translations.idiomatic: Stars between Chamber and Hook and Lock, or their scattering, mean earthquakes and rivers turning clear.

sentences.zh: 心三星，天王正位也。

translations.literal: Heart has three stars—the Celestial King's rightful seat.
translations.idiomatic: Heart's three stars mark the Celestial King's rightful throne.

sentences.zh: 中星曰明堂，天子位，為大辰，主天下之賞罰。

translations.literal: The central star is called the Bright Hall, the Son of Heaven's seat and the Great Mark; it governs reward and punishment under Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: The central star is the Bright Hall—the Son of Heaven's throne and Great Mark, governing reward and punishment throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 天下變動，心星見祥。

translations.literal: When the realm changes, Heart stars show auspicious signs.
translations.idiomatic: When the realm shifts, Heart stars reveal omens.

sentences.zh: 星明大，天下同，暗則主暗。

translations.literal: If the stars are bright and large, the realm is united; if dim, the ruler is obscured.
translations.idiomatic: Bright, large stars mean unity; dim stars, a darkened sovereign.

sentences.zh: 前星為太子，其星不明，太子不得代。

translations.literal: The front star is the Heir Apparent; if it is not bright, the Heir Apparent cannot succeed.
translations.idiomatic: The front star is the Heir Apparent; if dim, he cannot inherit.

sentences.zh: 後星為庶子，後星明，庶子代。

translations.literal: The rear star is the secondary son; if bright, a secondary son will succeed.
translations.idiomatic: The rear star is a secondary son; if bright, he will take the throne.

sentences.zh: 心星變黑，大人有憂。

translations.literal: If Heart stars turn black, great men face grief.
translations.idiomatic: Black Heart stars bring sorrow to great men.

sentences.zh: 直則王失勢，動則國有憂急，角搖則有兵，離則人流。

translations.literal: If straight, the king loses power; if they move, the state faces urgent trouble; if the horns shake, there is war; if they scatter, the people flee.
translations.idiomatic: Straight alignment means the king loses power; movement, urgent crisis; quivering horns, war; scattering, mass flight.

sentences.zh: 尾九星，後宮之場，妃后之府。

translations.literal: Tail has nine stars—the inner precinct of the rear palace, the consorts' residence.
translations.idiomatic: Tail's nine stars form the rear palace precinct and the consorts' quarters.

sentences.zh: 上第一星，后也；

translations.literal: The first star is the empress;
translations.idiomatic: The first star is the empress;

sentences.zh: 次三星，夫人；

translations.literal: the next three are ladies;
translations.idiomatic: the next three are noble ladies;

sentences.zh: 次星，嬪妾。

translations.literal: the remaining stars are concubines.
translations.idiomatic: the rest are concubines.

sentences.zh: 第三星傍一星，名曰神宮，解衣之內室。

translations.literal: Beside the third star is one called the Spirit Palace—the inner chamber where one removes garments.
translations.idiomatic: Beside the third star lies the Spirit Palace, the inner chamber of disrobing.

sentences.zh: 尾亦為九子。

translations.literal: Tail also represents the nine sons.
translations.idiomatic: Tail also images the nine sons.

sentences.zh: 星色欲均明，大小相承，則後宮有敘，多子孫。

translations.literal: The stars should be evenly bright, large and small in proper succession—then the rear palace is ordered and there are many descendants.
translations.idiomatic: Even brightness and orderly succession among the stars mean an ordered rear palace and many heirs.

sentences.zh: 星微細暗，后有憂疾。

translations.literal: If the stars are faint, fine, and dim, the empress faces illness and grief.
translations.idiomatic: Faint, fine, dim stars bring the empress illness and worry.

sentences.zh: 疏遠，后失勢。

translations.literal: If scattered and distant, the empress loses power.
translations.idiomatic: Scattered, distant stars mean the empress loses influence.

sentences.zh: 動搖則君臣不和，天下亂。

translations.literal: If they tremble, ruler and ministers are at odds and the realm falls into chaos.
translations.idiomatic: Trembling stars mean discord between ruler and ministers and chaos in the realm.

sentences.zh: 就聚則大水。

translations.literal: If they gather close, great floods come.
translations.idiomatic: Gathering close foretells great floods.

sentences.zh: 箕四星，亦後宮妃后之府。

translations.literal: Winnowing Basket has four stars—also the rear palace of consorts and empresses.
translations.idiomatic: Winnowing Basket's four stars also form the consorts' and empresses' rear palace.

sentences.zh: 亦曰天津，一曰天雞。

translations.literal: It is also called the Celestial Ford and, alternatively, the Celestial Cock.
translations.idiomatic: Also called the Celestial Ford—or the Celestial Cock.

sentences.zh: 主八風，凡日月宿在箕、東壁、翼、軫者，風起。

translations.literal: It governs the eight winds: whenever sun or moon lodge in Winnowing Basket, Eastern Wall, Wings, or Chariot, wind rises.
translations.idiomatic: It governs the eight winds: when sun or moon lodge in Winnowing Basket, Eastern Wall, Wings, or Chariot, wind rises.

sentences.zh: 又主口舌，主客蠻夷胡貉，故蠻胡將動，先表箕焉。

translations.literal: It also governs speech and debate, hosts and guests, barbarians and northern tribes—so when southern tribes stir, Winnowing Basket shows the sign first.
translations.idiomatic: It also governs speech, diplomacy, and barbarian peoples—when southern tribes stir, Winnowing Basket signals first.

sentences.zh: 星大明直則穀熟，內外有差。

translations.literal: If the stars are very bright and straight, grain ripens—with differences between inner and outer domains.
translations.idiomatic: Very bright, straight stars mean ripe grain, with variation between center and periphery.

sentences.zh: 就聚細微，天下憂。

translations.literal: If they gather close and grow faint, the realm faces grief.
translations.idiomatic: Gathering faint stars bring national sorrow.

sentences.zh: 動則蠻夷有使來。

translations.literal: If they move, barbarian envoys arrive.
translations.idiomatic: Movement means envoys from barbarian lands.

sentences.zh: 離徙則人流動，不出三日，大風。

translations.literal: If they scatter and shift, the people move; within three days, great wind.
translations.idiomatic: Scattering and shifting mean mass migration—and great wind within three days.

sentences.zh: 北方：南斗六星，天廟也，丞相太宰之位，主褒賢進士，稟授爵祿，又主兵。

translations.literal: The North: Southern Dipper has six stars—the Celestial Temple, the seat of the Chancellor and Grand Steward, governing praise of worthies and advancement of scholars, granting ranks and stipends, and also governing armies.
translations.idiomatic: In the north, Southern Dipper's six stars form the Celestial Temple—the Chancellor and Grand Steward's seat—praising worthies, advancing scholars, granting ranks and stipends, and governing armies.

sentences.zh: 一曰天機。

translations.literal: It is also called the Celestial Mechanism.
translations.idiomatic: Also called the Celestial Mechanism.

sentences.zh: 南二星魁，天梁也。

translations.literal: The two southern stars are the Dipper Head and the Celestial Beam.
translations.idiomatic: The two southern stars are the Dipper Head and Celestial Beam.

sentences.zh: 中央二星，天相也。

translations.literal: The two central stars are the Celestial Minister.
translations.idiomatic: The two central stars are the Celestial Minister.

sentences.zh: 北二星杓，天府庭也，亦為天子壽命之期也。

translations.literal: The two northern stars are the Dipper Handle and the Celestial Treasury court—also the span of the Son of Heaven's life.
translations.idiomatic: The two northern stars are the Dipper Handle and Celestial Treasury court—also marking the Son of Heaven's lifespan.

sentences.zh: 將有天子之事，占於斗。

translations.literal: When affairs of the Son of Heaven are at hand, take omens from the Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: When royal affairs loom, read omens in the Dipper.

sentences.zh: 斗星盛明，王道平和，爵祿行。

translations.literal: When Dipper stars flourish and are bright, the royal Way is peaceful and ranks and stipends are granted.
translations.idiomatic: Flourishing, bright Dipper stars mean a peaceful royal Way and the granting of honors.

sentences.zh: 芒角動搖，天子愁，兵起移徙，其臣逐。

translations.literal: If horned rays tremble and shift, the Son of Heaven grieves, armies rise, ministers are driven out.
translations.idiomatic: Horned, trembling, shifting stars bring royal grief, war, and the expulsion of ministers.

sentences.zh: 牽牛六星，天之關梁，主犧牲事。

translations.literal: Ox-Driver has six stars—Heaven's barrier and bridge, governing sacrificial victims.
translations.idiomatic: Ox-Driver's six stars are Heaven's barrier and bridge, governing sacrificial offerings.

sentences.zh: 其北二星，一曰即路，一曰聚火。

translations.literal: Two stars north of it: one is called Road's End; one is called Gathered Fire.
translations.idiomatic: North of it are two stars: Road's End and Gathered Fire.

sentences.zh: 又曰，上一星主道路，次二星主關梁，次三星主南越。

translations.literal: It is also said: the upper star governs roads; the next two govern barriers and bridges; the last three govern Southern Yue.
translations.idiomatic: Also: the upper star governs roads; the middle pair, barriers and bridges; the lower three, Southern Yue.

sentences.zh: 搖動變色則占之。

translations.literal: If they tremble and change color, take omens from them.
translations.idiomatic: Trembling and color change call for divination.

sentences.zh: 星明大，王道昌，關梁通，牛貴。

translations.literal: If the stars are bright and large, the royal Way flourishes, barriers and bridges are open, and cattle are prized.
translations.idiomatic: Bright, large stars mean a flourishing royal Way, open passes, and costly cattle.

sentences.zh: 怒則馬貴。

translations.literal: If angry, horses are prized.
translations.idiomatic: Angry stars make horses costly.

sentences.zh: 不明失常，穀不登。

translations.literal: If not bright and abnormal, grain fails.
translations.idiomatic: Dim, abnormal stars mean failed harvests.

sentences.zh: 細則牛賤。

translations.literal: If fine, cattle are cheap.
translations.idiomatic: Fine stars mean cheap cattle.

sentences.zh: 中星移上下，牛多死。

translations.literal: If the central star shifts up or down, many cattle die.
translations.idiomatic: If the central star shifts vertically, many cattle die.

sentences.zh: 小星亡，牛多疫。

translations.literal: If small stars vanish, cattle suffer plague.
translations.idiomatic: Vanishing small stars bring cattle plague.

sentences.zh: 又曰，牽牛星動為牛災。

translations.literal: It is also said: when Ox-Driver stars move, cattle suffer disaster.
translations.idiomatic: Also: moving Ox-Driver stars bring cattle calamity.

sentences.zh: 須女四星，天之少府也。

translations.literal: Weaving Maid has four stars—the Celestial Minor Treasury.
translations.idiomatic: Weaving Maid's four stars form the Celestial Minor Treasury.

sentences.zh: 須，賤妾之稱，婦職之卑者也，主布帛裁制嫁娶。

translations.literal: Weaving Maid is the title of a lowly concubine—the humblest of women's duties—governing cloth, cutting garments, and marriage.
translations.idiomatic: Weaving Maid names a humble concubine—the lowest women's office—governing cloth, tailoring, and marriage.

sentences.zh: 星明，天下豐，女功昌，國充富。

translations.literal: If the stars are bright, the realm is abundant, women's work flourishes, and the state is rich.
translations.idiomatic: Bright stars mean abundance, flourishing women's crafts, and national wealth.

sentences.zh: 小暗則國藏虛。

translations.literal: If small and dim, the state's stores are empty.
translations.idiomatic: Small, dim stars mean empty treasuries.

sentences.zh: 動則有嫁娶出納裁制之事。

translations.literal: If they move, there are marriages, disbursements, and garment-cutting affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Movement brings marriages, disbursements, and tailoring.

sentences.zh: 虛二星，塚宰之官也。

translations.literal: Emptiness has two stars—the office of the Grand Minister.
translations.idiomatic: Emptiness's two stars are the Grand Minister's office.

sentences.zh: 主北方，主邑居廟常祭祀祝禱事，又主死喪哭泣。

translations.literal: It governs the north, settlements and temples, regular sacrifices and prayers, and also death, mourning, and weeping.
translations.idiomatic: It governs the north, towns and temples, regular sacrifice and prayer, and also death, mourning, and lament.

sentences.zh: 危三星，主天府天庫架屋，餘同虛占。

translations.literal: Rooftop has three stars—governing the Celestial Treasury, the Celestial Storehouse, and building frames; other omens follow Emptiness.
translations.idiomatic: Rooftop's three stars govern the Celestial Treasury, Celestial Storehouse, and roof frames; other omens follow Emptiness.

sentences.zh: 星不明，客有誅。

translations.literal: If the stars are not bright, guests face execution.
translations.idiomatic: Dim stars mean guests will be executed.

sentences.zh: 動則王者作宮殿，有土功。

translations.literal: If they move, the king builds palaces and there is earthwork.
translations.idiomatic: Movement means palace construction and earthworks.

sentences.zh: 墳墓四星，屬危之下，主死喪哭泣，為填墓也。

translations.literal: Tomb Mound has four stars beneath Rooftop—governing death, mourning, and weeping; they are the burial mounds.
translations.idiomatic: Tomb Mound's four stars below Rooftop govern death, mourning, and weeping—they are the graves.

sentences.zh: 星不明，天下旱。

translations.literal: If the stars are not bright, drought spreads under Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: Dim stars bring drought throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 動則有喪。

translations.literal: If they move, there is mourning.
translations.idiomatic: Movement brings mourning.

sentences.zh: 營室二星，天子之宮也。

translations.literal: Encampment has two stars—the Son of Heaven's palace.
translations.idiomatic: Encampment's two stars form the Son of Heaven's palace.

sentences.zh: 一曰玄宮，一曰清廟，又為軍糧之府及土功事。

translations.literal: One is called the Dark Palace; one the Pure Temple; it is also the storehouse of army grain and earthwork affairs.
translations.idiomatic: One is the Dark Palace; one the Pure Temple; it also holds army grain and governs earthworks.

sentences.zh: 星明國昌，小不明，祠祀鬼神不享，國家多疾。

translations.literal: If the stars are bright, the state flourishes; if small and not bright, sacrifices to ghosts and spirits go unaccepted and the state suffers much illness.
translations.idiomatic: Bright stars mean a flourishing state; small, dim stars mean rejected sacrifices and widespread disease.

sentences.zh: 動則有土功，兵出野。

translations.literal: If they move, there is earthwork and armies go into the field.
translations.idiomatic: Movement brings earthworks and armies in the field.

sentences.zh: 離宮六星，天子之別宮，主隱藏休息之所。

translations.literal: Detached Palace has six stars—the Son of Heaven's secondary palace, governing hidden places of rest and repose.
translations.idiomatic: Detached Palace's six stars are the Son of Heaven's retreat, governing hidden places of rest.

sentences.zh: 東壁二星，主文章，天下圖書之秘府也，主土功。

translations.literal: Eastern Wall has two stars—governing literature and the secret treasury of books and maps under Heaven, and also earthwork.
translations.idiomatic: Eastern Wall's two stars govern literature and the realm's secret archive of books and maps, and also earthworks.

sentences.zh: 星明，王者興，道術行，國多君子。

translations.literal: If the stars are bright, kings rise, the Way of learning flourishes, and the state has many gentlemen.
translations.idiomatic: Bright stars mean rising kings, flourishing learning, and many worthy men in the realm.

sentences.zh: 星失色，大小不同，王者好武，經士不用，圖書隱。

translations.literal: If the stars lose color and differ in size, the king loves warfare, scholars are not employed, and books are hidden away.
translations.idiomatic: Discolored, uneven stars mean a war-loving king, neglected scholars, and hidden libraries.

sentences.zh: 星動則有土功。

translations.literal: If the stars move, there is earthwork.
translations.idiomatic: Movement brings earthworks.

sentences.zh: 離徙就聚，為田宅事。

translations.literal: If they scatter and gather, there are fields and dwellings affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Scattering and gathering mean land and housing matters.

sentences.zh: 西方：奎十六星，天之武庫也。

translations.literal: The West: Strider has sixteen stars—the Celestial Armory.
translations.idiomatic: In the west, Strider's sixteen stars form the Celestial Armory.

sentences.zh: 一曰天豕，亦曰封豕。

translations.literal: It is also called the Celestial Boar and also the Enclosed Boar.
translations.idiomatic: Also called the Celestial Boar—or the Enclosed Boar.

sentences.zh: 主以兵禁暴，又主溝瀆。

translations.literal: It governs restraining violence by arms and also governs ditches and channels.
translations.idiomatic: It restrains violence by force and governs ditches and waterways.

sentences.zh: 西南大星，所謂天豕目，亦曰大將，欲其明。

translations.literal: The great star in the southwest is the so-called Celestial Boar's Eye—also called the Great General; it should be bright.
translations.idiomatic: The great southwestern star is the Celestial Boar's Eye—also the Great General—and should shine bright.

sentences.zh: 若帝淫佚，政不平，則奎有角。

translations.literal: If the emperor is dissolute and government is unjust, Strider shows horns.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor is dissolute and rule is unjust, Strider grows horns.

sentences.zh: 角動則有兵，不出年中，或有溝瀆之事。

translations.literal: If the horns move, armies rise; within the year, or there are ditch and channel affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Moving horns bring war within the year—or ditch and channel works.

sentences.zh: 又曰，奎中星明，水大出。

translations.literal: It is also said: if stars within Strider are bright, great floods come.
translations.idiomatic: Also: bright stars within Strider mean great floods.

sentences.zh: 婁三星，為天獄，主苑牧犧牲，供給郊祀，亦為興兵聚眾。

translations.literal: Bond has three stars—the Celestial Prison, governing parks, herds, and sacrificial victims for suburban rites, and also raising armies and gathering multitudes.
translations.idiomatic: Bond's three stars form the Celestial Prison, governing parks, livestock, suburban sacrifices, and mustering armies.

sentences.zh: 星明，天下平和，郊祀大享，多子孫。

translations.literal: If the stars are bright, the realm is peaceful, suburban rites are grandly performed, and there are many descendants.
translations.idiomatic: Bright stars mean peace, grand suburban rites, and many heirs.

sentences.zh: 動則有聚眾。

translations.literal: If they move, multitudes gather.
translations.idiomatic: Movement means mass gatherings.

sentences.zh: 星直則有執主之命者。

translations.literal: If the stars stand straight, there is one who holds the sovereign's command.
translations.idiomatic: Straight stars mean someone holds the sovereign's mandate.

sentences.zh: 就聚，國不安。

translations.literal: If they gather close, the state is unsettled.
translations.idiomatic: Gathering close means national unrest.

sentences.zh: 胃三星，天之廚藏，主倉廩五穀府也。

translations.literal: Stomach has three stars—the Celestial Kitchen Store, the granary of the five grains.
translations.idiomatic: Stomach's three stars are the Celestial Kitchen Store—the granary of the five grains.

sentences.zh: 明則和平倉實，動則有輸運事，就聚則谷貴人流。

translations.literal: If bright, there is peace and full granaries; if they move, there is transport of supplies; if they gather, grain is costly and people flee.
translations.idiomatic: Bright stars mean peace and full stores; movement, supply transport; gathering, dear grain and flight.

sentences.zh: 昴七星，天之耳目也，主西方，主獄事。

translations.literal: Hairy Head has seven stars—the ears and eyes of Heaven, governing the west and prison affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Hairy Head's seven stars are Heaven's ears and eyes, governing the west and prisons.

sentences.zh: 又為旄頭，胡星也。

translations.literal: It is also the Battle Standard—the star of the Hu.
translations.idiomatic: It is also the Battle Standard—the Hu peoples' star.

sentences.zh: 又主喪。

translations.literal: It also governs mourning.
translations.idiomatic: It also governs mourning.

sentences.zh: 昴畢間為天街，天子出，旄頭罕畢以前驅，此其義也。

translations.literal: Between Hairy Head and Net is the Celestial Street: when the Son of Heaven goes forth, the battle standard and Net complete the vanguard—this is the meaning.
translations.idiomatic: Between Hairy Head and Net lies the Celestial Street: when the Son of Heaven rides out, the battle standard and Net lead the vanguard.

sentences.zh: 黃道之所經也。

translations.literal: The Yellow Path passes through it.
translations.idiomatic: The ecliptic runs through it.

sentences.zh: 昴明則天下牢獄平。

translations.literal: If Hairy Head is bright, prisons under Heaven are settled.
translations.idiomatic: Bright Hairy Head means prisons are at peace throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 昴六星皆明，與大星等，大水。

translations.literal: If all six Hairy Head stars are bright and equal to the great star, great flood.
translations.idiomatic: If six stars match the great star in brightness, great flood.

sentences.zh: 七星黃，兵大起。

translations.literal: If the seven stars turn yellow, armies rise greatly.
translations.idiomatic: Yellow seven stars mean war on a vast scale.

sentences.zh: 一星亡，為兵喪。

translations.literal: If one star vanishes, there is war and mourning.
translations.idiomatic: A vanished star brings war and mourning.

sentences.zh: 搖動，有大臣下獄，及白衣之會。

translations.literal: If they tremble, great ministers are imprisoned and there is a gathering in white.
translations.idiomatic: Trembling stars mean imprisoned ministers and a white-clad assembly.

sentences.zh: 大而數盡動，若跳躍者，胡兵大起。

translations.literal: If large and all move as if leaping, Hu armies rise greatly.
translations.idiomatic: Large, leaping stars mean massive Hu armies.

sentences.zh: 一星獨跳躍，餘不動者，胡欲犯邊境也。

translations.literal: If one star leaps alone while the rest do not move, the Hu intend to raid the border.
translations.idiomatic: One leaping star alone means the Hu plan border raids.

sentences.zh: 畢八星，主邊兵，主弋獵。

translations.literal: Net has eight stars—governing frontier armies and hunting with bow.
translations.idiomatic: Net's eight stars govern frontier armies and archery hunts.

sentences.zh: 其大星曰天高，一曰邊將，主四夷之尉也。

translations.literal: Its great star is called Celestial Height—also the Frontier General, governing the wardens of the four barbarians.
translations.idiomatic: Its great star is Celestial Height—also the Frontier General, warden of the four barbarians.

sentences.zh: 星明大則遠夷來貢，天下安。

translations.literal: If the stars are bright and large, distant tribes come with tribute and the realm is at peace.
translations.idiomatic: Bright, large stars mean distant tribute and peace.

sentences.zh: 失色則邊亂。

translations.literal: If they lose color, the frontier falls into chaos.
translations.idiomatic: Discolored stars mean frontier disorder.

sentences.zh: 一星亡，為兵喪。

translations.literal: If one star vanishes, there is war and mourning.
translations.idiomatic: A vanished star brings war and mourning.

sentences.zh: 動搖，邊城兵起，有讒臣。

translations.literal: If they tremble, frontier garrisons rise in arms and there are slanderous ministers.
translations.idiomatic: Trembling stars mean frontier war and slanderous ministers.

sentences.zh: 離徙，天下獄亂。

translations.literal: If they scatter, prisons under Heaven fall into chaos.
translations.idiomatic: Scattering means chaos in prisons throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 就聚，法令酷。

translations.literal: If they gather, laws are harsh.
translations.idiomatic: Gathering means cruel laws.

sentences.zh: 附耳一星在畢下，主聽得失，伺愆邪，察不祥。

translations.literal: Attached Ear is one star beneath Net—governing hearing of gain and loss, watching for faults and wickedness, and detecting ill omens.
translations.idiomatic: Attached Ear, one star below Net, hears gain and loss, watches for wickedness, and detects ill omens.

sentences.zh: 星盛則中國微，有盜賊，邊候驚，外國反，鬭兵連年。

translations.literal: If the star flourishes, the central realm weakens, there are bandits, frontier alarms, foreign revolt, and armies clash year after year.
translations.idiomatic: A flourishing star weakens the center, brings bandits, frontier alarms, foreign revolt, and years of war.

sentences.zh: 若移動，佞讒行，兵大起，邊尤甚。

translations.literal: If it moves, flattery and slander flourish, armies rise greatly, especially on the frontier.
translations.idiomatic: Movement brings flattery, slander, and especially frontier war.

sentences.zh: 月入畢，多雨。

translations.literal: When the moon lodges in Net, much rain.
translations.idiomatic: Moon in Net brings heavy rain.

sentences.zh: 觜觿三星，為三軍之候，行軍之藏府，主葆旅，收斂萬物。

translations.literal: Turtle Beak has three stars—the outpost of the three armies, the storehouse of marching armies, governing encampments and troops, gathering all things.
translations.idiomatic: Turtle Beak's three stars are the three armies' outpost and marching storehouse, governing encampments and gathering all things.

sentences.zh: 明則軍儲盈，將得勢。

translations.literal: If bright, army stores are full and generals gain power.
translations.idiomatic: Bright stars mean full army stores and powerful generals.

sentences.zh: 動而明，盜賊群行，葆旅起。

translations.literal: If they move and are bright, bandits roam in groups and encampments rise.
translations.idiomatic: Moving bright stars mean bandit bands and rising encampments.

sentences.zh: 動移，將有逐者。

translations.literal: If they shift, a general will be driven out.
translations.idiomatic: Shifting stars mean a general's expulsion.

sentences.zh: 參十星，一曰參伐，一曰大辰，一曰天市，一曰鈇鉞，主斬刈。

translations.literal: Three Stars has ten stars—also called Three Stars' Punishment, Great Mark, Celestial Market, and Axe and Halberd, governing cutting down and reaping.
translations.idiomatic: Three Stars' ten stars are also Punishment, Great Mark, Celestial Market, and Axe and Halberd, governing execution and reaping.

sentences.zh: 又為天獄，主殺伐。

translations.literal: It is also the Celestial Prison, governing killing and punishment.
translations.idiomatic: Also the Celestial Prison, governing execution and punishment.

sentences.zh: 又主權衡，所以平理也。

translations.literal: It also governs the balance—by which things are weighed and settled.
translations.idiomatic: It also holds the balance by which justice is weighed.

sentences.zh: 又主邊城，為九譯，故不欲其動也。

translations.literal: It also governs the frontier city and the nine interpreters—therefore one does not wish it to move.
translations.idiomatic: It also governs frontier cities and the nine interpreters—hence it should not move.

sentences.zh: 參，白獸之體。

translations.literal: Three Stars is the body of the White Beast.
translations.idiomatic: Three Stars is the White Beast's body.

sentences.zh: 其中三星橫列，三將也。

translations.literal: Three stars in the middle lie crosswise—the three generals.
translations.idiomatic: Three stars crosswise in the center are the three generals.

sentences.zh: 東北曰左肩，主左將。

translations.literal: The northeast is called the Left Shoulder, governing the Left General.
translations.idiomatic: The northeast is the Left Shoulder—the Left General.

sentences.zh: 西北曰右肩，主右將。

translations.literal: The northwest is called the Right Shoulder, governing the Right General.
translations.idiomatic: The northwest is the Right Shoulder—the Right General.

sentences.zh: 東南曰左足，主後將軍。

translations.literal: The southeast is called the Left Foot, governing the Rear General.
translations.idiomatic: The southeast is the Left Foot—the Rear General.

sentences.zh: 西南曰右足，主偏將軍。

translations.literal: The southwest is called the Right Foot, governing the Flank General.
translations.idiomatic: The southwest is the Right Foot—the Flank General.

sentences.zh: 故《黃帝占》參應七將。

translations.literal: Thus the Yellow Emperor's divination text says Three Stars corresponds to seven generals.
translations.idiomatic: The Yellow Emperor's omen text says Three Stars images seven generals.

sentences.zh: 中央三小星曰伐，天之都尉也，主胡、鮮卑、戎狄之國，故不欲明。

translations.literal: Three small stars in the center are called Punishment—the Celestial Commandant, governing the lands of Hu, Xianbei, and the northern tribes; therefore one does not wish them bright.
translations.idiomatic: Three central small stars are Punishment—the Celestial Commandant over Hu, Xianbei, and northern tribes; they should not shine bright.

sentences.zh: 七將皆明大，天下兵精也。

translations.literal: If all seven generals are bright and large, armies under Heaven are strong.
translations.idiomatic: Bright, large seven generals mean strong armies throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 王道缺則芒角張。

translations.literal: If the royal Way is lacking, horned rays spread wide.
translations.idiomatic: A failing royal Way spreads horned rays wide.

sentences.zh: 伐星明與參等，大臣皆謀，兵起。

translations.literal: If Punishment stars are as bright as Three Stars, all great ministers plot and armies rise.
translations.idiomatic: Punishment matching Three Stars in brightness means ministerial plots and war.

sentences.zh: 參星失色，軍散。

translations.literal: If Three Stars lose color, armies scatter.
translations.idiomatic: Discolored Three Stars mean scattered armies.

sentences.zh: 參芒角動搖，邊候有急，天下兵起。

translations.literal: If Three Stars' horned rays tremble, frontier alarms are urgent and armies rise under Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: Trembling horned Three Stars mean urgent frontier alarms and realm-wide war.

sentences.zh: 又曰，有斬伐之事。

translations.literal: It is also said: there are affairs of execution and punishment.
translations.idiomatic: Also: execution and punishment are at hand.

sentences.zh: 參星移，客伐主。

translations.literal: If Three Stars shift, guests attack the host.
translations.idiomatic: Shifting Three Stars mean guests strike the host.

sentences.zh: 參左足入玉井中，兵大起，秦大水，若有喪，山石為怪。

translations.literal: If Three Stars' left foot enters the Jade Well, armies rise greatly, Qin suffers great flood, or there is mourning, and mountains and stones show strange signs.
translations.idiomatic: If the left foot enters the Jade Well, great armies rise, Qin floods, mourning comes, and mountains and stones turn strange.

sentences.zh: 參星差戾，王臣貳。

translations.literal: If Three Stars are irregular and skewed, royal ministers are disloyal.
translations.idiomatic: Irregular, skewed Three Stars mean disloyal ministers.

sentences.zh: 南方：東井八星，天之南門，黃道所經，天之亭候。

translations.literal: The South: Eastern Well has eight stars—the Southern Gate of Heaven, where the Yellow Path passes, Heaven's lookout post.
translations.idiomatic: In the south, Eastern Well's eight stars are Heaven's Southern Gate, on the ecliptic—Heaven's lookout.

sentences.zh: 主水衡事，法令所取平也。

translations.literal: It governs water-balance affairs—the standard by which laws are weighed.
translations.idiomatic: It governs water-balance affairs—the standard for weighing laws.

sentences.zh: 王者用法平，則井星明而端列。

translations.literal: If the king employs law fairly, Well stars are bright and stand upright in row.
translations.idiomatic: Fair law makes Well stars bright and upright in row.

sentences.zh: 鉞一星，附井之前，主伺淫奢而斬之，故不欲其明。

translations.literal: Axe is one star attached before the Well—governing watching for excess and dissipation and executing it; therefore one does not wish it bright.
translations.idiomatic: Axe, one star before the Well, watches for excess and executes it—hence it should not shine bright.

sentences.zh: 明與井齊，則用鉞，大臣有斬者，以欲殺也。

translations.literal: If bright and level with the Well, the axe is used—great ministers are executed, for the desire to kill.
translations.idiomatic: Bright and level with the Well, the axe falls—ministers die by the urge to kill.

sentences.zh: 月宿井，有風雨。

translations.literal: When the moon lodges in the Well, there is wind and rain.
translations.idiomatic: Moon in the Well brings wind and rain.

sentences.zh: 輿鬼五星，天目也，主視，明察奸謀。

translations.literal: Carriage Ghost has five stars—the Eye of Heaven, governing sight and discerning treacherous plots.
translations.idiomatic: Carriage Ghost's five stars are Heaven's Eye, discerning treacherous plots.

sentences.zh: 東北星主積馬，東南星主積兵，西南星主積布帛，西北星主積金玉，隨變占之。

translations.literal: The northeast star governs stored horses; the southeast, stored armies; the southwest, stored cloth and silk; the northwest, stored gold and jade—take omens according to their changes.
translations.idiomatic: Northeast stores horses; southeast, armies; southwest, cloth; northwest, gold and jade—read omens from their changes.

sentences.zh: 中央為積屍，主死喪祠祀。

translations.literal: The center is Stored Corpses, governing death, mourning, and sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: The center is Stored Corpses, governing death, mourning, and sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 一曰鈇質，主誅斬。

translations.literal: One is called Axe and Anvil, governing execution.
translations.idiomatic: One is Axe and Anvil, governing execution.

sentences.zh: 鬼星明大，谷成。

translations.literal: If Ghost stars are bright and large, grain ripens.
translations.idiomatic: Bright, large Ghost stars mean ripe grain.

sentences.zh: 不明，人散。

translations.literal: If not bright, people scatter.
translations.idiomatic: Dim stars mean scattered people.

sentences.zh: 動而光，上賦斂重，徭役多。

translations.literal: If they move and shine, taxes are heavy and corvée labor is many.
translations.idiomatic: Moving, shining stars mean heavy taxes and much corvée.

sentences.zh: 星徙，人愁，政令急。

translations.literal: If the stars shift, people grieve and edicts are urgent.
translations.idiomatic: Shifting stars bring popular grief and urgent edicts.

sentences.zh: 鬼質欲其忽忽不明則安，明則兵起，大臣誅。

translations.literal: Ghost and Anvil should be hazy and not bright for peace; if bright, armies rise and great ministers are executed.
translations.idiomatic: Ghost and Anvil should be hazy for peace; if bright, war comes and ministers die.

sentences.zh: 柳八星，天之廚宰也，主尚食，和滋味，又主雷雨，若女主驕奢。

translations.literal: Willow has eight stars—the Celestial Kitchen Steward, governing the imperial kitchen and blending flavors, and also governing thunder and rain; if the queen is arrogant and extravagant.
translations.idiomatic: Willow's eight stars are the Celestial Kitchen Steward, governing imperial cuisine, flavors, thunder, and rain—and an arrogant queen.

sentences.zh: 一曰天相，一曰天庫，一曰注，又主木功。

translations.literal: One is called the Celestial Minister; one the Celestial Storehouse; one the Conduit; it also governs woodwork.
translations.idiomatic: One is the Celestial Minister; one the Celestial Storehouse; one the Conduit; it also governs woodwork.

sentences.zh: 星明，大臣重慎，國安，廚食具。

translations.literal: If the stars are bright, great ministers are cautious, the state is secure, and kitchen provisions are complete.
translations.idiomatic: Bright stars mean cautious ministers, a secure state, and full kitchens.

sentences.zh: 注舉首，王命興，輔佐出。

translations.literal: If the Conduit raises its head, the king's command rises and assistants come forth.
translations.idiomatic: If the Conduit lifts its head, royal commands issue and assistants emerge.

sentences.zh: 星直，天下謀伐其主。

translations.literal: If the stars stand straight, the realm plots to attack its lord.
translations.idiomatic: Straight stars mean the realm plots against its lord.

sentences.zh: 星就聚，兵滿國門。

translations.literal: If the stars gather close, armies fill the state gates.
translations.idiomatic: Gathering close means armies at the gates.

sentences.zh: 七星七星，一名天都，主衣裳文繡，又主急兵，守盜賊，故欲明。

translations.literal: Seven Stars has seven stars—also called the Celestial Capital, governing robes and embroidered patterns, and also urgent armies and guarding against bandits; therefore one wishes them bright.
translations.idiomatic: Seven Stars' seven stars are also the Celestial Capital, governing robes and embroidery, urgent armies, and bandit defense—they should shine bright.

sentences.zh: 星明，王道昌，暗則賢良不處，天下空，天子疾。

translations.literal: If the stars are bright, the royal Way flourishes; if dim, worthy men do not hold office, the realm is empty, and the Son of Heaven falls ill.
translations.idiomatic: Bright stars mean a flourishing royal Way; dim stars, no worthy men, an empty realm, and a sick Son of Heaven.

sentences.zh: 動則兵起，離則易政。

translations.literal: If they move, armies rise; if they scatter, government changes.
translations.idiomatic: Movement brings war; scattering, change of government.

sentences.zh: 張六星，主珍寶，宗廟所用及衣服，又主天廚，飲食賞賚之事。

translations.literal: Extended Net has six stars—governing precious treasures, what the ancestral temple uses and clothing, and also the Celestial Kitchen and affairs of food, drink, and rewards.
translations.idiomatic: Extended Net's six stars govern treasures, temple goods and clothing, the Celestial Kitchen, and feasting and rewards.

sentences.zh: 星明則王者行五禮，得天之中。

translations.literal: If the stars are bright, the king performs the five rites and obtains the center of Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: Bright stars mean the king performs the five rites and holds Heaven's center.

sentences.zh: 動則賞賚，離徙天下有逆人，就聚有兵。

translations.literal: If they move, rewards are granted; if they scatter, rebels appear under Heaven; if they gather, there is war.
translations.idiomatic: Movement brings rewards; scattering, rebels; gathering, war.

sentences.zh: 翼二十二星，天之樂府，主俳倡戲樂，又主夷狄遠客，負海之賓。

translations.literal: Wings has twenty-two stars—the Celestial Music Bureau, governing entertainers and theatrical music, and also barbarian distant guests and guests from beyond the sea.
translations.idiomatic: Wings' twenty-two stars are the Celestial Music Bureau, governing performers and music, and also distant barbarian guests from beyond the sea.

sentences.zh: 星明大，禮樂興，四夷賓。

translations.literal: If the stars are bright and large, rites and music flourish and the four barbarians come as guests.
translations.idiomatic: Bright, large stars mean flourishing rites and music and barbarian guests.

sentences.zh: 動則蠻夷使來，離徙則天子舉兵。

translations.literal: If they move, barbarian envoys come; if they scatter, the Son of Heaven raises armies.
translations.idiomatic: Movement brings barbarian envoys; scattering, the Son of Heaven's armies.

sentences.zh: 軫四星，主塚宰輔臣也，主車騎，主載任。

translations.literal: Chariot has four stars—governing the Grand Minister and assisting ministers, chariots and cavalry, and bearing loads.
translations.idiomatic: Chariot's four stars govern the Grand Minister and assistants, chariots and cavalry, and bearing loads.

sentences.zh: 有軍出入，皆占於軫。

translations.literal: When armies go out or enter, all omens are taken from Chariot.
translations.idiomatic: All omens of armies entering or leaving are read in Chariot.

sentences.zh: 又主風，主死喪。

translations.literal: It also governs wind and governs death and mourning.
translations.idiomatic: It also governs wind, death, and mourning.

sentences.zh: 軫星明，則車駕備。

translations.literal: If Chariot stars are bright, the royal carriage is equipped.
translations.idiomatic: Bright Chariot stars mean the royal carriage stands ready.

sentences.zh: 動則車騎用。

translations.literal: If they move, chariots and cavalry are deployed.
translations.idiomatic: Movement deploys chariots and cavalry.

sentences.zh: 離徙，天子憂。

translations.literal: If they scatter, the Son of Heaven grieves.
translations.idiomatic: Scattering brings the Son of Heaven grief.

sentences.zh: 就聚，兵大起。

translations.literal: If they gather, armies rise greatly.
translations.idiomatic: Gathering brings great armies.

sentences.zh: 轄星，傅軫兩傍，主王侯。

translations.literal: Axle-pin stars flank Chariot on both sides, governing kings and marquises.
translations.idiomatic: Axle-pin stars flank Chariot, governing kings and marquises.

sentences.zh: 左轄為王者同姓，右轄為異姓。

translations.literal: The left axle-pin is the king's same surname; the right, different surname.
translations.idiomatic: The left axle-pin marks the royal clan; the right, other surnames.

sentences.zh: 星明，兵大起。

translations.literal: If the stars are bright, armies rise greatly.
translations.idiomatic: Bright stars mean great armies.

sentences.zh: 遠軫凶。

translations.literal: If far from Chariot, ill omen.
translations.idiomatic: Distance from Chariot is ominous.

sentences.zh: 軫轄舉，南蠻侵。

translations.literal: If Chariot's axle-pins rise, southern tribes invade.
translations.idiomatic: Rising axle-pins mean southern tribes invade.

sentences.zh: 車無轄，國主憂。

translations.literal: A chariot without axle-pins—the state lord grieves.
translations.idiomatic: A chariot without axle-pins brings the ruler grief.

sentences.zh: 長沙一星，在軫之中，主壽命。

translations.literal: Changsha is one star within Chariot, governing lifespan.
translations.idiomatic: Changsha, one star in Chariot, governs lifespan.

sentences.zh: 明則主壽長，子孫昌。

translations.literal: If bright, the lord lives long and descendants flourish.
translations.idiomatic: Brightness means long life and flourishing heirs.

sentences.zh: 右四方二十八宿並輔官一百八十二星。

translations.literal: To the right: the four quarters' twenty-eight lodges together with assisting officials—one hundred eighty-two stars.
translations.idiomatic: Beyond this: the twenty-eight lodges of the four quarters with their assisting stars—one hundred eighty-two in all.

sentences.zh: 星官在二十八宿之外者

translations.literal: Star officials outside the twenty-eight lodges:
translations.idiomatic: Star officials beyond the twenty-eight lodges:

sentences.zh: 庫樓十星，其六大星為庫，南四星為樓，在角南。

translations.literal: Storehouse Tower has ten stars—six great stars are the storehouse, four southern stars the tower—south of Horn.
translations.idiomatic: Storehouse Tower's ten stars lie south of Horn: six form the storehouse, four the tower.

sentences.zh: 一曰天庫，兵車之府也。

translations.literal: One is called the Celestial Storehouse—the arsenal of chariots and armies.
translations.idiomatic: Also the Celestial Storehouse—the chariot and army arsenal.

sentences.zh: 旁十五星，三三而聚者，柱也。

translations.literal: Fifteen stars beside, gathering three by three, are the Pillars.
translations.idiomatic: Fifteen nearby stars in threes are the Pillars.

sentences.zh: 中央四小星，衡也。

translations.literal: Four small stars in the center are the Crossbeam.
translations.idiomatic: Four central small stars are the Crossbeam.

sentences.zh: 主陳兵。

translations.literal: They govern arraying troops.
translations.idiomatic: They govern troop formations.

sentences.zh: 又曰，天庫空則兵四合。

translations.literal: It is also said: if the Celestial Storehouse is empty, armies converge from four sides.
translations.idiomatic: Also: an empty Celestial Storehouse means armies from all four sides.

sentences.zh: 東北二星曰陽門，主守隘塞也。

translations.literal: Two stars in the northeast are called the Solar Gate, governing guarding passes and barriers.
translations.idiomatic: Two northeastern stars are the Solar Gate, guarding passes and barriers.

sentences.zh: 南門二星在庫樓南，天之外門也。

translations.literal: Southern Gate has two stars south of Storehouse Tower—Heaven's outer gate.
translations.idiomatic: Southern Gate's two stars lie south of Storehouse Tower—Heaven's outer gate.

sentences.zh: 主守兵。

translations.literal: It governs guarding armies.
translations.idiomatic: It governs army defense.

sentences.zh: 平星二星，在庫樓北，平天下之法獄事，廷尉之象也。

translations.literal: Level Stars are two stars north of Storehouse Tower—settling legal cases and prisons under Heaven, the image of the Minister of Justice.
translations.idiomatic: Level Stars, north of Storehouse Tower, settle law and prisons—the Minister of Justice's image.

sentences.zh: 天門二星，在平星北。

translations.literal: Heavenly Gate has two stars north of Level Stars.
translations.idiomatic: Heavenly Gate's two stars lie north of Level Stars.

sentences.zh: 亢南七星曰折威，主斬殺。

translations.literal: Seven stars south of Neck are called Broken Power, governing execution.
translations.idiomatic: Seven stars south of Neck are Broken Power, governing execution.

sentences.zh: 頓頑二星，在折威東南，主考囚情狀，察詐偽也。

translations.literal: Slow Stubborn has two stars southeast of Broken Power, governing examination of prisoners' circumstances and detecting fraud.
translations.idiomatic: Slow Stubborn, southeast of Broken Power, examines prisoners and detects fraud.

sentences.zh: 騎官二十七星，在氐南，若天子武賁，主宿衛。

translations.literal: Cavalry Officer has twenty-seven stars south of Root—like the Son of Heaven's martial guard, governing night watch.
translations.idiomatic: Cavalry Officer's twenty-seven stars south of Root are the Son of Heaven's guard, governing night watch.

sentences.zh: 東端一星，騎陳將軍，騎將也。

translations.literal: One star at the eastern end is the Cavalry Array General—the cavalry commander.
translations.idiomatic: The eastern star is the Cavalry Array General—the cavalry commander.

sentences.zh: 南三星車騎，車騎之將也。

translations.literal: Three southern stars are Chariot and Cavalry—the chariot and cavalry generals.
translations.idiomatic: Three southern stars are the chariot and cavalry generals.

sentences.zh: 陣車三星，在騎官東北，革車也。

translations.literal: Array Chariot has three stars northeast of Cavalry Officer—leather chariots.
translations.idiomatic: Array Chariot's three stars northeast of Cavalry Officer are leather chariots.

sentences.zh: 積卒十二星，在房心南，主為衛也。

translations.literal: Accumulated Soldiers has twelve stars south of Chamber and Heart, governing defense.
translations.idiomatic: Accumulated Soldiers' twelve stars south of Chamber and Heart govern defense.

sentences.zh: 他星守之，近臣誅。

translations.literal: If other stars guard them, close ministers are executed.
translations.idiomatic: If other stars guard them, close ministers die.

sentences.zh: 從官二星，在積卒西北。

translations.literal: Attendant Officials has two stars northwest of Accumulated Soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: Attendant Officials' two stars lie northwest of Accumulated Soldiers.

sentences.zh: 龜五星，在尾南，主卜，以占吉凶。

translations.literal: Tortoise has five stars south of Tail, governing divination to read fortune and misfortune.
translations.idiomatic: Tortoise's five stars south of Tail govern divination for good and ill.

sentences.zh: 傅說一星，在尾後。

translations.literal: Fu Yue is one star behind Tail.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Yue is one star behind Tail.

sentences.zh: 傅說主章祝巫官也。

translations.literal: Fu Yue governs the Zhang prayer-official and shaman officers.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Yue governs the Zhang prayer-officials and shamans.

sentences.zh: 章，請號之聲也。

translations.literal: Zhang is the sound of petitioning and calling.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang is the sound of petition and invocation.

sentences.zh: 主王后之內祭祀，以祈子孫，廣求胤嗣。

translations.literal: It governs the queen's inner sacrifices, praying for descendants and broadly seeking heirs.
translations.idiomatic: It governs the queen's inner sacrifices, praying for heirs.

sentences.zh: 《詩》云：「克禋克祀，以弗無子。

translations.literal: The Odes says: "Perform the fragrant rites, perform the sacrifices, lest there be no sons."
translations.idiomatic: The Odes says: "Perform the fragrant rites and sacrifices, lest there be no sons."

sentences.zh: 」此之象也。

translations.literal: This is its image.
translations.idiomatic: This is its image.

sentences.zh: 星明大，王者多子孫。

translations.literal: If the star is bright and large, kings have many descendants.
translations.idiomatic: Bright, large stars mean many royal heirs.

sentences.zh: 魚一星，在尾後河中，主陰事，知雲雨之期也。

translations.literal: Fish is one star in the river behind Tail, governing yin affairs and knowing the season of clouds and rain.
translations.idiomatic: Fish, one star in the river behind Tail, governs yin affairs and foretells rain.

sentences.zh: 星不明，則魚多亡，若魚少。

translations.literal: If the star is not bright, many fish perish—or few fish.
translations.idiomatic: Dim stars mean fish die—or fish are scarce.

sentences.zh: 動搖則大水暴出。

translations.literal: If it trembles, great flood bursts forth.
translations.idiomatic: Trembling brings sudden great flood.

sentences.zh: 出漢中，則大魚多死。

translations.literal: If it leaves the Milky Way, many great fish die.
translations.idiomatic: Leaving the Milky Way kills many great fish.

sentences.zh: 杵三星，在箕南，杵給庖舂。

translations.literal: Pestle has three stars south of Winnowing Basket—the pestle supplying the kitchen for pounding.
translations.idiomatic: Pestle's three stars south of Winnowing Basket supply the kitchen mill.

sentences.zh: 客星入杵臼，天下有急。

translations.literal: If a guest star enters Pestle and Mortar, the realm faces urgency.
translations.idiomatic: A guest star in Pestle and Mortar means national crisis.

sentences.zh: 糠一星，在箕舌前，杵西北。

translations.literal: Chaff is one star before Winnowing Basket's tongue, northwest of Pestle.
translations.idiomatic: Chaff lies before Winnowing Basket's tongue, northwest of Pestle.

sentences.zh: 鱉十四星，在南斗南。

translations.literal: Turtle has fourteen stars south of Southern Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: Turtle's fourteen stars lie south of Southern Dipper.

sentences.zh: 鱉為水蟲，歸太陰。

translations.literal: The turtle is a water creature, belonging to Great Yin.
translations.idiomatic: The turtle is a water creature of Great Yin.

sentences.zh: 有星守之，白衣會，主有水令。

translations.literal: If stars guard it, there is a white-clad assembly and water edicts.
translations.idiomatic: Stars guarding it bring white-clad assembly and water edicts.

sentences.zh: 農丈人一星，在南斗西南，老農主稼穡也。

translations.literal: Old Farmer is one star southwest of Southern Dipper—the old farmer governing crops.
translations.idiomatic: Old Farmer, southwest of Southern Dipper, governs crops.

sentences.zh: 狗二星，在南斗魁前，主吠守。

translations.literal: Dog has two stars before the Southern Dipper head, governing barking and guarding.
translations.idiomatic: Dog's two stars before the Dipper head govern barking and watch.

sentences.zh: 天田九星，在牛南。

translations.literal: Celestial Field has nine stars south of Ox.
translations.idiomatic: Celestial Field's nine stars lie south of Ox.

sentences.zh: 羅堰九星，在牽牛東，岠馬也，以壅畜水潦，灌溉溝渠也。

translations.literal: Net Weir has nine stars east of Ox-Driver—blocking horses, to dam and store floodwater and irrigate ditches and channels.
translations.idiomatic: Net Weir's nine stars east of Ox-Driver block horses, dam floodwater, and irrigate channels.

sentences.zh: 九坎九星，在牽牛南。

translations.literal: Nine Pitfalls has nine stars south of Ox-Driver.
translations.idiomatic: Nine Pitfalls' nine stars lie south of Ox-Driver.

sentences.zh: 坎，溝渠也，所以導達泉源，疏瀉盈溢，通溝洫也。

translations.literal: Pitfall means ditches and channels—guiding spring sources, draining overflow, opening irrigation.
translations.idiomatic: Pitfalls are ditches—guiding springs, draining overflow, opening irrigation.

sentences.zh: 九坎間十星曰天池，一曰三池，一曰天海，主灌溉事。

translations.literal: Ten stars between Nine Pitfalls are called the Celestial Pool—also Three Pools, also Celestial Sea, governing irrigation.
translations.idiomatic: Ten stars between Nine Pitfalls are the Celestial Pool—also Three Pools or Celestial Sea—governing irrigation.

sentences.zh: 九坎東列星：北一星曰齊，齊北二星曰趙，趙北一星曰鄭，鄭北一星曰越，越東二星曰周，周東南北列二星曰秦，秦南二星曰代，代西一星曰晉，晉北一星曰韓，韓北一星曰魏，魏西一星曰楚，楚南一星曰燕。

translations.literal: Stars east of Nine Pitfalls in row: north one is Qi; north of Qi two is Zhao; north of Zhao one is Zheng; north of Zheng one is Yue; east of Yue two is Zhou; east of Zhou north-south two is Qin; south of Qin two is Dai; west of Dai one is Jin; north of Jin one is Han; north of Han one is Wei; west of Wei one is Chu; south of Chu one is Yan.
translations.idiomatic: East of Nine Pitfalls: Qi, Zhao, Zheng, Yue, Zhou, Qin, Dai, Jin, Han, Wei, Chu, Yan—each star marking its state.

sentences.zh: 其星有變，各以其國。

translations.literal: If their stars change, each according to its state.
translations.idiomatic: Star changes affect each state accordingly.

sentences.zh: 秦、代東三星南北列，曰離瑜。

translations.literal: East of Qin and Dai, three stars north-south in row, are called Li and Yu.
translations.idiomatic: Three stars east of Qin and Dai are Li and Yu.

sentences.zh: 離圭衣也，瑜玉飾，皆婦人之服星也。

translations.literal: Li is jade scepter and garment; Yu is jade ornament—both are stars of women's dress.
translations.idiomatic: Li is jade scepter and robe; Yu is jade ornament—women's dress stars.

sentences.zh: 虛南二星曰哭，哭東二星曰泣，泣哭皆近墳墓。

translations.literal: Two stars south of Emptiness are called Weeping; two stars east of Weeping are called Crying—Weeping and Crying both lie near tombs.
translations.idiomatic: South of Emptiness: Weeping; east of Weeping: Crying—both near graves.

sentences.zh: 泣南十三星，曰天壘城，如貫索狀，主北夷丁零、匈奴。

translations.literal: Thirteen stars south of Crying are called the Celestial Rampart City, shaped like a rope noose, governing the northern tribes Dingling and Xiongnu.
translations.idiomatic: Thirteen stars south of Crying are the Celestial Rampart, noose-shaped, governing Dingling and Xiongnu.

sentences.zh: 敗臼四星，在虛危南，知凶災。

translations.literal: Broken Mortar has four stars south of Emptiness and Rooftop, knowing calamity and disaster.
translations.idiomatic: Broken Mortar's four stars south of Emptiness and Rooftop foretell disaster.

sentences.zh: 他星守之，饑兵起。

translations.literal: If other stars guard them, famine and armies rise.
translations.idiomatic: Other stars guarding them bring famine and war.

sentences.zh: 危南二星曰蓋屋，主治宮室之官也。

translations.literal: Two stars south of Rooftop are called Canopy House, governing the office of palace construction.
translations.idiomatic: Two stars south of Rooftop are Canopy House, governing palace construction.

sentences.zh: 虛梁四星，在蓋屋南，主園陵寢廟。

translations.literal: Empty Beam has four stars south of Canopy House, governing gardens, tombs, and ancestral temples.
translations.idiomatic: Empty Beam's four stars south of Canopy House govern gardens, tombs, and temples.

sentences.zh: 非人所處，故曰虛梁。

translations.literal: Not where humans dwell—hence called Empty Beam.
translations.idiomatic: Not a human dwelling—hence Empty Beam.

sentences.zh: 室南六星曰雷電。

translations.literal: Six stars south of Encampment are called Thunder and Lightning.
translations.idiomatic: Six stars south of Encampment are Thunder and Lightning.

sentences.zh: 室西南二星曰土功吏，主司過度。

translations.literal: Two stars southwest of Encampment are called the Earthwork Clerk, governing excess in construction.
translations.idiomatic: Two stars southwest of Encampment are the Earthwork Clerk, governing construction excess.

sentences.zh: 壁南二星曰土公，土公西南五星曰礔礪，礔礪南四星曰雲雨，皆在壘壁北。

translations.literal: Two stars south of Wall are called Earth Lord; five stars southwest of Earth Lord are called Thunder Stone; four stars south of Thunder Stone are called Cloud and Rain—all north of Rampart Wall.
translations.idiomatic: South of Wall: Earth Lord; southwest, Thunder Stone; south, Cloud and Rain—all north of Rampart Wall.

sentences.zh: 羽林四十五星，在營室南。

translations.literal: Forest of Feathers has forty-five stars south of Encampment.
translations.idiomatic: Forest of Feathers' forty-five stars lie south of Encampment.

sentences.zh: 一曰天軍，主軍騎，又主翼王也。

translations.literal: One is called the Celestial Army, governing cavalry armies, and also governing supporting kings.
translations.idiomatic: Also the Celestial Army, governing cavalry and supporting kings.

sentences.zh: 壘壁陣十二星，在羽林北，羽林之垣壘也，主軍位，為營壅也。

translations.literal: Rampart Wall Array has twelve stars north of Forest of Feathers—the rampart wall of the Forest of Feathers, governing military positions and camp barriers.
translations.idiomatic: Rampart Wall Array's twelve stars north of Forest of Feathers form the camp rampart, governing military positions.

sentences.zh: 五星有在天軍中者，皆為兵起，熒惑、太白、辰星尤甚。

translations.literal: If any of the five planets is within the Celestial Army, armies rise—Mars, Venus, and Mercury especially.
translations.idiomatic: Any five planets in the Celestial Army mean war—especially Mars, Venus, and Mercury.

sentences.zh: 北落師門一星，在羽林南。

translations.literal: Northern Falling Master Gate is one star south of Forest of Feathers.
translations.idiomatic: Northern Falling Master Gate is one star south of Forest of Feathers.

sentences.zh: 北者，宿在北方也。

translations.literal: North means the lodge lies in the north.
translations.idiomatic: North means the lodge stands in the north.

sentences.zh: 落，天之蕃落也。

translations.literal: Falling means Heaven's outer barrier.
translations.idiomatic: Falling is Heaven's outer barrier.

sentences.zh: 師，眾也。

translations.literal: Master means multitudes.
translations.idiomatic: Master means multitudes.

sentences.zh: 師門猶軍門也。

translations.literal: Master Gate is like the army gate.
translations.idiomatic: Master Gate is the army gate.

sentences.zh: 長安城北門曰北落門，以象北也。

translations.literal: Chang'an city's north gate is called Northern Falling Gate, imaging the north.
translations.idiomatic: Chang'an's north gate is Northern Falling Gate, imaging the north.

sentences.zh: 主非常，以候兵。

translations.literal: It governs the extraordinary and watches for armies.
translations.idiomatic: It governs the extraordinary and watches for war.

sentences.zh: 有星守之，虜入塞中，兵起。

translations.literal: If stars guard it, barbarians enter the passes and armies rise.
translations.idiomatic: Stars guarding it mean barbarians enter the passes and war rises.

sentences.zh: 北落西北有十星，曰天錢。

translations.literal: Northwest of Northern Falling are ten stars called Celestial Coins.
translations.idiomatic: Ten stars northwest of Northern Falling are Celestial Coins.

sentences.zh: 北落西南一星，曰天綱，主武帳。

translations.literal: One star southwest of Northern Falling is called the Celestial Net, governing the military tent.
translations.idiomatic: One star southwest of Northern Falling is the Celestial Net, governing the military tent.

sentences.zh: 北落東南九星，曰八魁，主張禽獸。

translations.literal: Nine stars southeast of Northern Falling are called the Eight Chiefs, governing netting birds and beasts.
translations.idiomatic: Nine stars southeast of Northern Falling are the Eight Chiefs, netting birds and beasts.

sentences.zh: 客星入之，多盜賊。

translations.literal: If a guest star enters them, many bandits.
translations.idiomatic: Guest stars entering mean many bandits.

sentences.zh: 八魁西北三星曰鈇質，一曰鈇鉞。

translations.literal: Three stars northwest of Eight Chiefs are called Axe and Anvil—also Axe and Halberd.
translations.idiomatic: Three stars northwest of Eight Chiefs are Axe and Anvil—or Axe and Halberd.

sentences.zh: 有星入之，皆為大臣誅。

translations.literal: If stars enter them, all mean great ministers executed.
translations.idiomatic: Stars entering mean ministers executed.

sentences.zh: 奎南七星曰外屏。

translations.literal: Seven stars south of Strider are called the Outer Screen.
translations.idiomatic: Seven stars south of Strider are the Outer Screen.

sentences.zh: 外屏南七星曰天溷，廁也。

translations.literal: Seven stars south of Outer Screen are called the Celestial Privy—the latrine.
translations.idiomatic: Seven stars south of Outer Screen are the Celestial Privy—the latrine.

sentences.zh: 屏所以障之也。

translations.literal: The screen is what blocks it.
translations.idiomatic: The screen blocks it.

sentences.zh: 天溷南一星曰土司空，主水土之事故，又知禍殃也。

translations.literal: One star south of the Celestial Privy is called Earth Minister, governing earth and water affairs and also knowing calamity and disaster.
translations.idiomatic: One star south of the Privy is Earth Minister, governing earth and water and foretelling disaster.

sentences.zh: 客星入之，多土功，天下大疾。

translations.literal: If a guest star enters, much earthwork and great pestilence under Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: Guest stars entering mean much earthwork and great plague.

sentences.zh: 婁東五星曰左更，山虞也，主澤藪竹木之屬，亦主仁智。

translations.literal: Five stars east of Bond are called Left Watch—Mountain Warden, governing marshes, thickets, bamboo and trees, and also benevolence and wisdom.
translations.idiomatic: Five stars east of Bond are Left Watch—the Mountain Warden, governing marshes, woods, and wisdom.

sentences.zh: 婁西五星曰右更，牧師也，主養牛馬之屬，亦主禮義。

translations.literal: Five stars west of Bond are called Right Watch—the Herdsman, governing raising cattle and horses, and also rites and righteousness.
translations.idiomatic: Five stars west of Bond are Right Watch—the Herdsman, governing livestock and rites.

sentences.zh: 二更，秦爵名也。

translations.literal: The two Watches are Qin rank names.
translations.idiomatic: The two Watches are Qin noble titles.

sentences.zh: 天倉六星，在婁南，倉谷所藏也。

translations.literal: Celestial Granary has six stars south of Bond—where stored grain is kept.
translations.idiomatic: Celestial Granary's six stars south of Bond store grain.

sentences.zh: 星黃而大，歲熟。

translations.literal: If the stars are yellow and large, the year ripens.
translations.idiomatic: Yellow, large stars mean a ripe year.

sentences.zh: 西南四星曰天庾，積廚粟之所也。

translations.literal: Four stars in the southwest are called Celestial Storehouse—the place where kitchen grain is accumulated.
translations.idiomatic: Four southwestern stars are Celestial Storehouse, holding kitchen grain.

sentences.zh: 天囷十三星在胃南。

translations.literal: Celestial Round Granary has thirteen stars south of Stomach.
translations.idiomatic: Celestial Round Granary's thirteen stars lie south of Stomach.

sentences.zh: 囷，倉廩之屬也，主給禦糧也。

translations.literal: Round granary belongs to the category of storehouses, governing supply of imperial grain.
translations.idiomatic: A round granary governs imperial grain supply.

sentences.zh: 星見則囷倉實，不見即虛。

translations.literal: If the stars appear, granaries are full; if not seen, they are empty.
translations.idiomatic: Visible stars mean full granaries; invisible, empty stores.

sentences.zh: 天廩四星在昴南，一曰天」Ｗ，主畜黍稷，以供饗祀，《春秋》所謂禦廩，此之象也。

translations.literal: Celestial Manger has four stars south of Hairy Head—also called Celestial Storehouse, governing livestock of millet and grain for sacrifice; the Spring and Autumn Annals' "Imperial Manger" images this.
translations.idiomatic: Celestial Manger's four stars south of Hairy Head store millet for sacrifice—the "Imperial Manger" of the Spring and Autumn Annals.

sentences.zh: 天苑十六星，在昴畢南，天子之苑囿，養禽獸之所也，主馬牛羊。

translations.literal: Celestial Park has sixteen stars south of Net and Hairy Head—the Son of Heaven's park, where birds and beasts are kept, governing horses, cattle, sheep, and goats.
translations.idiomatic: Celestial Park's sixteen stars south of Net and Hairy Head are the royal preserve for horses and livestock.

sentences.zh: 星明則牛馬盈，希則死。

translations.literal: If the stars are bright, cattle and horses are abundant; if sparse, they die.
translations.idiomatic: Bright stars mean abundant livestock; sparse stars, deaths.

sentences.zh: 苑西六星曰芻槁，以供牛馬之食也。

translations.literal: Six stars west of the Park are called Fodder Hay—for feeding cattle and horses.
translations.idiomatic: Six stars west of the Park are Fodder Hay for livestock.

sentences.zh: 一曰天積，天子之藏府也。

translations.literal: One is called Celestial Accumulation—the Son of Heaven's treasury.
translations.idiomatic: Also Celestial Accumulation—the Son of Heaven's treasury.

sentences.zh: 星盛則歲豐穰，希則貨財散。

translations.literal: If the stars flourish, the year is abundant; if sparse, wealth scatters.
translations.idiomatic: Flourishing stars mean abundance; sparse stars, scattered wealth.

sentences.zh: 苑南十三星曰天園，植果菜之所也。

translations.literal: Thirteen stars south of the Park are called Celestial Garden—where fruits and vegetables are planted.
translations.idiomatic: Thirteen stars south of the Park are Celestial Garden for fruits and vegetables.

sentences.zh: 畢附耳南八星，曰天節，主使臣之所持者也。

translations.literal: Eight stars south of Attached Ear are called Celestial Knob—the envoy's staff.
translations.idiomatic: Eight stars south of Attached Ear are Celestial Knob, the envoy's staff.

sentences.zh: 天節下九星，曰九州殊口，曉方俗之官，通重譯者也。

translations.literal: Nine stars below Celestial Knob are called Nine Provinces Special Mouth—the office that understands local customs and interprets through multiple translators.
translations.idiomatic: Nine stars below Celestial Knob are Nine Provinces Special Mouth, interpreting foreign customs.

sentences.zh: 畢柄西五星曰天陰。

translations.literal: Five stars west of Net's handle are called Celestial Yin.
translations.idiomatic: Five stars west of Net's handle are Celestial Yin.

sentences.zh: 參旗九星在參西，一曰天旗，一曰天弓，主司弓弩之張，候變禦難。

translations.literal: Banner of Three Stars has nine stars west of Three Stars—also Celestial Banner, also Celestial Bow, governing the drawing of bows and crossbows and watching for change and defense against calamity.
translations.idiomatic: Banner of Three Stars' nine stars west of Three Stars govern bows and watch for calamity.

sentences.zh: 玉井四星，在參左足下，主水漿，以給廚。

translations.literal: Jade Well has four stars at Three Stars' left foot—governing water and broth for the kitchen.
translations.idiomatic: Jade Well's four stars at Three Stars' left foot supply the kitchen.

sentences.zh: 西南九星曰九游，天子之旗也。

translations.literal: Nine stars in the southwest are called Nine Wanderers—the Son of Heaven's banners.
translations.idiomatic: Nine southwestern stars are Nine Wanderers—the Son of Heaven's banners.

sentences.zh: 玉井東南四星曰軍井，行軍之井也。

translations.literal: Four stars southeast of Jade Well are called Army Well—the marching army's well.
translations.idiomatic: Four stars southeast of Jade Well are Army Well for marching armies.

sentences.zh: 軍井未達，將不言渴，名取此也。

translations.literal: Before Army Well is reached, the general does not speak of thirst—this is where the name comes from.
translations.idiomatic: Before Army Well is reached, generals do not speak of thirst—hence the name.

sentences.zh: 屏二星在玉井南，屏為屏風。

translations.literal: Screen has two stars south of Jade Well—the screen is a wind screen.
translations.idiomatic: Screen's two stars south of Jade Well form a wind screen.

sentences.zh: 客星入之，四足蟲大疾。

translations.literal: If a guest star enters, four-legged creatures suffer great pestilence.
translations.idiomatic: Guest stars entering bring plague among four-legged creatures.

sentences.zh: 天廁四星，在屏東，溷也，主觀天下疾病。

translations.literal: Celestial Privy has four stars east of Screen—the latrine, governing watching disease under Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: Celestial Privy's four stars east of Screen watch disease throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 天矢一星在廁南，色黃則吉，他色皆凶。

translations.literal: Celestial Arrow is one star south of the Privy—yellow color is auspicious; all other colors are inauspicious.
translations.idiomatic: Celestial Arrow south of the Privy: yellow is auspicious; other colors, ill.

sentences.zh: 軍市十三星，在參東南，天軍貿易之市，使有無通也。

translations.literal: Army Market has thirteen stars southeast of Three Stars—the Celestial Army's trading market, enabling exchange of goods.
translations.idiomatic: Army Market's thirteen stars southeast of Three Stars trade army supplies.

sentences.zh: 野雞一星，主變怪，在軍市中。

translations.literal: Wild Chicken is one star governing strange transformations, in Army Market.
translations.idiomatic: Wild Chicken in Army Market governs strange transformations.

sentences.zh: 軍市西南二星曰丈人，丈人東二星曰子，子東二星曰孫。

translations.literal: Two stars southwest of Army Market are called Elder; two stars east of Elder are called Son; two stars east of Son are called Grandson.
translations.idiomatic: Southwest of Army Market: Elder; east of Elder: Son; east of Son: Grandson.

sentences.zh: 東井西南四星曰水府，主水之官也。

translations.literal: Four stars southwest of Eastern Well are called Water Office, governing the water officials.
translations.idiomatic: Four stars southwest of Eastern Well are Water Office, governing water officials.

sentences.zh: 東井南垣之東四星，曰四瀆，江、河、淮、濟之精也。

translations.literal: Four stars at the eastern wall of Eastern Well are called Four Channels—the essences of the Yangtze, Yellow River, Huai, and Ji.
translations.idiomatic: Four stars at Eastern Well's eastern wall are Four Channels—Yangtze, Yellow, Huai, and Ji.

sentences.zh: 狼一星，在東井東南。

translations.literal: Wolf is one star southeast of Eastern Well.
translations.idiomatic: Wolf is one star southeast of Eastern Well.

sentences.zh: 狼為野將，主侵掠。

translations.literal: Wolf is the wild general, governing raiding and plunder.
translations.idiomatic: Wolf is the wild general, governing raids and plunder.

sentences.zh: 色有常，不欲變動也。

translations.literal: Its color should be constant—one does not wish it to change and move.
translations.idiomatic: Its color should stay constant—not shift and move.

sentences.zh: 角而變色動搖，盜賊萌，胡兵起，人相食。

translations.literal: If horned and changing color and trembling, bandits arise, Hu armies rise, and people eat one another.
translations.idiomatic: Horns, color change, and trembling bring bandits, Hu armies, and cannibalism.

sentences.zh: 躁則人主不靜，不居其宮，馳騁天下。

translations.literal: If restless, the ruler is unsettled, does not dwell in his palace, and gallops across the realm.
translations.idiomatic: Restlessness means an unsettled ruler who gallops across the realm.

sentences.zh: 北七星曰天狗，主守財。

translations.literal: Seven stars north are called Celestial Dog, governing guarding wealth.
translations.idiomatic: Seven northern stars are Celestial Dog, guarding wealth.

sentences.zh: 弧九星在狼東南，天弓也，主備盜賊，常向於狼。

translations.literal: Bow has nine stars southeast of Wolf—the Celestial Bow, guarding against bandits, always facing Wolf.
translations.idiomatic: Bow's nine stars southeast of Wolf guard against bandits, facing Wolf.

sentences.zh: 弧矢動移，不如常者，多盜賊，胡兵大起。

translations.literal: If Bow and Arrow move and shift unlike normal, many bandits and great Hu armies rise.
translations.idiomatic: Abnormal Bow and Arrow movement brings bandits and great Hu armies.

sentences.zh: 狼弧張，害及胡，天下乖亂。

translations.literal: If Bow and Arrow are drawn, harm reaches the Hu and the realm falls into chaos.
translations.idiomatic: Drawn Bow and Arrow harm the Hu and bring chaos.

sentences.zh: 又曰，天弓張，天下盡兵，主與臣相謀。

translations.literal: It is also said: if the Celestial Bow is drawn, armies fill the realm and lord and minister plot against each other.
translations.idiomatic: Also: a drawn Celestial Bow means armies everywhere and lord-minister plots.

sentences.zh: 弧南六星為天社。

translations.literal: Six stars south of Bow are the Celestial Altar.
translations.idiomatic: Six stars south of Bow are the Celestial Altar.

sentences.zh: 昔共工氏之子句龍，能平水土，故祀以配社，其精為星。

translations.literal: In antiquity Gong Gong's son Gou Long could level water and earth—therefore he was sacrificed to match the altar; his essence became a star.
translations.idiomatic: Gou Long, Gong Gong's son, leveled water and earth—his essence became the altar star.

sentences.zh: 老人一星在弧南，一曰南極。

translations.literal: Old Man is one star south of Bow—also called South Pole.
translations.idiomatic: Old Man, one star south of Bow, is also the South Pole.

sentences.zh: 常以秋分之旦見於丙，春分之夕而沒于丁。

translations.literal: It regularly appears at dawn on the autumn equinox in the bing direction and sets at dusk on the spring equinox in the ding direction.
translations.idiomatic: It appears at autumn-equinox dawn in bing and sets at spring-equinox dusk in ding.

sentences.zh: 見則化平，主壽昌，亡則君危代天。

translations.literal: If seen, transformation is peaceful, the lord lives long; if gone, the ruler is in peril and replaces Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: If seen, peace and long life; if gone, the ruler faces peril.

sentences.zh: 常以秋分候之南郊。

translations.literal: Regularly at the autumn equinox it is observed at the southern suburb.
translations.idiomatic: It is observed at the southern suburb on the autumn equinox.

sentences.zh: 柳南六星曰外廚。

translations.literal: Six stars south of Willow are called Outer Kitchen.
translations.idiomatic: Six stars south of Willow are Outer Kitchen.

sentences.zh: 廚南一星曰天紀，主禽獸之齒。
