translations.idiomatic: Rebellion or cruelty, lost spring government—emergence sets term.

sentences.zh: 皆主君征也。

translations.literal: All govern the lord's campaigns.
translations.idiomatic: All govern royal campaigns.

sentences.zh: 熒惑之精，流為析旦、蚩尤旗、昭明、司危、天攙。

translations.literal: Sparkling Fire's essence flows into Split Dawn, Chiyou Banner, Zhaoming, Siwei, Celestial Coiling.
translations.idiomatic: Sparkling Fire's essence: Split Dawn, Chiyou Banner, Zhaoming, Siwei, Coiling.

sentences.zh: 一曰析旦，或曰昭旦，主弱之符。

translations.literal: One is Split Dawn, or Zhaodawn—lord-weak token.
translations.idiomatic: One: Split Dawn or Zhaodawn—lord-weak token.

sentences.zh: 又曰，析旦橫出，參櫂百尺，為相誅滅。

translations.literal: Also: Split Dawn crossing out,参 oars one hundred chi—chancellor executed and destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: Split Dawn crossing:参 oars hundred chi—chancellor destroyed.

sentences.zh: 二曰蚩尤旗。

translations.literal: Two is Chiyou Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Two: Chiyou Banner.

sentences.zh: 或曰，旋星散為蚩尤旗。

translations.literal: Or: Whirl Star scatters into Chiyou Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Or: Whirl Star scatters into Chiyou Banner.

sentences.zh: 或曰，蚩尤旗，五星盈縮之所生也。

translations.literal: Or: Chiyou Banner—born of five stars' expansion and contraction.
translations.idiomatic: Or: born of five stars' expansion and contraction.

sentences.zh: 狀類彗而後曲，象旗。

translations.literal: Shape like comet then curved, image of banner.
translations.idiomatic: Comet-like then curved like banner.

sentences.zh: 或曰，四望無雲，獨見赤雲，蚩尤旗也。

translations.literal: Or: four directions no clouds, alone red cloud seen—Chiyou Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Or: alone red cloud—Chiyou Banner.

sentences.zh: 或曰，蚩尤旗如箕，可長二丈，末有星。

translations.literal: Or: Chiyou Banner like winnowing basket, two zhang long, tail has star.
translations.idiomatic: Or: like winnowing basket, two zhang, tail star.

sentences.zh: 又曰，亂國之王，眾邪並積，有雲若植雚竹長，黃上白下，名曰蚩尤旗。

translations.literal: Also: disordered state's king, many evils accumulated, cloud like planted reed bamboo long, yellow above white below—called Chiyou Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Disordered king: yellow-white cloud like reed—Chiyou Banner.

sentences.zh: 主誅逆國。

translations.literal: Governing executing rebellious states.
translations.idiomatic: Executing rebellious states.

sentences.zh: 又曰，帝將怒，則蚩尤旗出。

translations.literal: Also: Emperor about to rage—Chiyou Banner emerges.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor raging: Chiyou Banner emerges.

sentences.zh: 又曰，虐王反度，則蚩尤旗出。

translations.literal: Also: tyrant king reverses measure—Chiyou Banner emerges.
translations.idiomatic: Tyrant reversing measure: Chiyou Banner emerges.

sentences.zh: 或曰，本類星，而後委曲，其像旗Ｔ，可長二三丈。

translations.literal: Or: originally star-like, then curved afterward, image of banner T, two-three zhang long.
translations.idiomatic: Or: star-like then curved banner, two-three zhang.

sentences.zh: 見則王者旗鼓，大行征伐，四方兵大起。

translations.literal: Seen—king's banners and drums, great campaigning, armies rise in four quarters.
translations.idiomatic: Seen: royal banners, great campaigns, armies everywhere.

sentences.zh: 不然，國有大喪。

translations.literal: Otherwise, state has great mourning.
translations.idiomatic: Otherwise: great mourning.

sentences.zh: 三曰昭明者，五星變出於西方，名曰昭明，金之氣也。

translations.literal: Three is Zhaoming—five stars' transformation emerging west, called Zhaoming, metal qi.
translations.idiomatic: Three: Zhaoming—five stars west, metal qi.

sentences.zh: 又曰，赤彗分為昭明。

translations.literal: Also: red comet divides into Zhaoming.
translations.idiomatic: Red comet divides into Zhaoming.

sentences.zh: 昭明滅光，象如太白，七芒，故以為起霸之征。

translations.literal: Zhaoming extinguished light, image like Great White, seven rays—therefore taken as hegemony-rising omen.
translations.idiomatic: Zhaoming like Great White with seven rays—hegemony omen.

sentences.zh: 或曰，機星散為昭明。

translations.literal: Or: Pivot Star scatters into Zhaoming.
translations.idiomatic: Pivot scatters into Zhaoming.

sentences.zh: 又曰，西方有星，望之去地可六丈而有光，其類太白，數動，察之中赤，是謂西方之野星，名曰昭明。

translations.literal: Also: western star, seen six zhang from earth with light, Great White class, often moving, red within—western field star, called Zhaoming.
translations.idiomatic: Western star six zhang, Great White-like, red within—Zhaoming.

sentences.zh: 出則兵大起。

translations.literal: Emergence—armies rise greatly.
translations.idiomatic: Emergence: great armies.

sentences.zh: 其出也，下有喪。

translations.literal: At emergence, mourning below.
translations.idiomatic: At emergence: mourning below.

sentences.zh: 出南方，則西方之邦失地。

translations.literal: Emerging south—western states lose land.
translations.idiomatic: South emergence: western states lose land.

sentences.zh: 或曰，昭明如太白，不行，主起有德。

translations.literal: Or: Zhaoming like Great White, not moving—lord rises with virtue.
translations.idiomatic: Or: Zhaoming like unmoving Great White—virtuous rise.

sentences.zh: 又曰，西方有星，大而白，有角，目下視之，名曰昭明。

translations.literal: Also: western star, large and white with horns, looking down—called Zhaoming.
translations.idiomatic: Western large white horned star looking down: Zhaoming.

sentences.zh: 金之精，出則兵大起。

translations.literal: Metal essence emerging—armies rise greatly.
translations.idiomatic: Metal essence: great armies.

sentences.zh: 若守房心，國有喪，必有屠城。

translations.literal: If guarding Chamber and Heart—state mourning, certainly slaughtered city.
translations.idiomatic: Guarding Chamber-Heart: mourning, slaughtered city.

sentences.zh: 昭明下則為天狗，所下者大戰流血。

translations.literal: Below Zhaoming becomes Celestial Dog—where it descends, great battle and flowing blood.
translations.idiomatic: Below Zhaoming: Celestial Dog—great battle and blood.

sentences.zh: 四曰司危。

translations.literal: Four is Siwei.
translations.idiomatic: Four: Siwei.

sentences.zh: 或曰，機星散為司危。

translations.literal: Or: Pivot Star scatters into Siwei.
translations.idiomatic: Pivot scatters into Siwei.

sentences.zh: 又曰，白彗之氣，分為司危。

translations.literal: Also: white comet qi divides into Siwei.
translations.idiomatic: White comet qi divides into Siwei.

sentences.zh: 司危平，以為乖爭之征。

translations.literal: Siwei level—taken as strife and contention omen.
translations.idiomatic: Siwei level: strife omen.

sentences.zh: 或曰，司危星大，有毛，兩角。

translations.literal: Or: Siwei star large, with hair, two horns.
translations.idiomatic: Or: large with hair and two horns.

sentences.zh: 又曰，司危星類太白，數動，察之而赤。

translations.literal: Also: Siwei star like Great White, often moving, red when examined.
translations.idiomatic: Like Great White, moving, red within.

sentences.zh: 司危出，強國盈，主擊強侯兵也。

translations.literal: Siwei emerging—strong state full, lord strikes strong marquis armies.
translations.idiomatic: Siwei emerging: strong state, strikes strong marquis.

sentences.zh: 又曰，司危見則主失法，期八年，豪傑起，天子以不義失國。

translations.literal: Also: Siwei seen—lord loses law, term eight years, heroes rise, Son of Heaven loses state by injustice.
translations.idiomatic: Siwei seen: lost law, eight years, heroes, lost state.

sentences.zh: 有聲之臣，行主德也。

translations.literal: Minister with voice—traveling lord's virtue.
translations.idiomatic: Voiced minister: lord's virtue.

sentences.zh: 又曰，司危見，則其下國相殘賊。

translations.literal: Also: Siwei seen—below state mutually slaughters bandits.
translations.idiomatic: Siwei seen: mutual slaughter below.

sentences.zh: 又曰，司危星出正西，西方之野星，去地可六丈，大而白，類太白。

translations.literal: Also: Siwei star emerging due west, western field star, six zhang from earth, large white, Great White class.
translations.idiomatic: Siwei due west, six zhang, Great White class.

sentences.zh: 一曰，見，兵起強。

translations.literal: One says: seen—armies rise strong.
translations.idiomatic: Seen: strong armies.

sentences.zh: 又曰，司危出則非，其下有兵衝不利。

translations.literal: Also: Siwei emerging then inauspicious, below army clash unfavorable.
translations.idiomatic: Siwei emerging: inauspicious, unfavorable clash below.

sentences.zh: 五曰天攙，其狀白小，數動，是謂攙星，一名斬星。

translations.literal: Five is Celestial Coiling—white small, often moving—called Coiling Star, also called Execution Star.
translations.idiomatic: Five: Celestial Coiling—white, moving—Coiling or Execution Star.

sentences.zh: 天攙主殺罰。

translations.literal: Celestial Coiling governs killing punishment.
translations.idiomatic: Coiling governs killing punishment.

sentences.zh: 又曰，天攙見，女主用事者，其本為主人。

translations.literal: Also: Celestial Coiling seen—queen consort holds affairs; its root is master.
translations.idiomatic: Coiling seen: queen holds affairs.

sentences.zh: 又曰，天攙出，其下相攙，為饑為兵，赤地千里，枯骨籍籍。

translations.literal: Also: Coiling emerging—below mutually coiling, famine and armies, red land thousand li, bones piled.
translations.idiomatic: Coiling emerging: mutual strife, famine, war, piled bones.

sentences.zh: 亦曰，天攙出，其國內亂。

translations.literal: Also: Coiling emerging—internal chaos in state.
translations.idiomatic: Coiling emerging: internal chaos.

sentences.zh: 又曰，太陽之精，赤鳥七宿之域，有謀反，恣虐為害，主失夏政。

translations.literal: Also: Great Yang essence, red bird seven lodges' domain—rebellion, cruelty, lost summer government.
translations.idiomatic: Great Yang essence, red bird domain—rebellion, lost summer.

sentences.zh: 填星之精，流為五殘、六賊、獄漢、大賁、炤星、絀流、茀星、旬始、擊咎。

translations.literal: Fill Star's essence flows into Five Ruins, Six Bandits, Prison Han, Great Ben, Bright Star, Frayed Flow, Fu Star, Ten Start.
translations.idiomatic: Fill essence: Five Ruins, Six Bandits, Prison Han, Great Ben, Bright Star, Frayed Flow, Fu, Ten Start.

sentences.zh: 一曰五殘。

translations.literal: One is Five Ruins.
translations.idiomatic: One: Five Ruins.

sentences.zh: 或曰，旋星散為五殘。

translations.literal: Or: Whirl Star scatters into Five Ruins.
translations.idiomatic: Whirl scatters into Five Ruins.

sentences.zh: 亦曰，蒼彗散為五殘。

translations.literal: Also: azure comet scatters into Five Ruins.
translations.idiomatic: Azure comet scatters into Five Ruins.

sentences.zh: 故為毀敗之征。

translations.literal: Therefore destruction and defeat omen.
translations.idiomatic: Destruction and defeat omen.

sentences.zh: 或曰，五殘五分。

translations.literal: Or: Five Ruins five parts.
translations.idiomatic: Or: five parts.

sentences.zh: 亦曰，一本而五枝也。

translations.literal: Also: one root and five branches.
translations.idiomatic: One root, five branches.

sentences.zh: 期九年，奸興。

translations.literal: Term nine years—wickedness rises.
translations.idiomatic: Nine years: wickedness rises.

sentences.zh: 三九二十七，大亂不可禁。

translations.literal: Three nines twenty-seven—great chaos cannot be forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: Three nines: unforbidden chaos.

sentences.zh: 又曰，五殘者，五行之變，出於東方，五殘木之氣也。

translations.literal: Also: Five Ruins—five phases' transformation, emerging east, Five Ruins wood qi.
translations.idiomatic: Five Ruins: wood qi east.

sentences.zh: 一曰，五縫又曰五殘，星出正東，東方之野星，狀類辰星，可去地六七丈，大而白，主乖亡。

translations.literal: One says Five Seam also Five Ruins—star emerging due east, eastern field star, Chronogram class, six-seven zhang from earth, large white, governing perverse ruin.
translations.idiomatic: Due east Chronogram-class star six-seven zhang: Five Ruins.

sentences.zh: 或曰，東方有星，望之去地可六丈，大而赤，察之中青。

translations.literal: Or: eastern star six zhang from earth, large red, green within when examined.
translations.idiomatic: Or: six zhang, large red, green within.

sentences.zh: 或曰，星表青氣如暈，有毛，其類歲星，是謂東方之野星，名曰五殘。

translations.literal: Or: star surface green qi like halo, with hair, Year Star class—eastern field star Five Ruins.
translations.idiomatic: Green halo, hair, Year Star class—eastern Five Ruins.

sentences.zh: 出則兵大起。

translations.literal: Emergence—armies rise greatly.
translations.idiomatic: Emergence: great armies.

sentences.zh: 其出也，下有喪。

translations.literal: At emergence, mourning below.
translations.idiomatic: At emergence: mourning below.

sentences.zh: 出北則東方之邦失地。

translations.literal: Emerging north—eastern states lose land.
translations.idiomatic: North emergence: eastern states lose land.

sentences.zh: 又曰，五殘出，四蕃虛，天子有急兵。

translations.literal: Also: Five Ruins emerging—four borders empty, Son of Heaven has urgent armies.
translations.idiomatic: Five Ruins: empty borders, urgent armies.

sentences.zh: 或曰，五殘大而赤，數動，察之有青。

translations.literal: Or: Five Ruins large red, often moving, green when examined.
translations.idiomatic: Large red moving, green within.

sentences.zh: 又曰，五殘出則兵起。

translations.literal: Also: Five Ruins emerging—armies rise.
translations.idiomatic: Five Ruins emerging: armies.

sentences.zh: 二曰六賊者，五行之氣，出於南方。

translations.literal: Two is Six Bandits—five phases' qi, emerging south.
translations.idiomatic: Two: Six Bandits—five phases south.

sentences.zh: 或曰，六賊火之氣也。

translations.literal: Or: Six Bandits fire qi.
translations.idiomatic: Or: fire qi.

sentences.zh: 或曰，六賊星形如彗。

translations.literal: Or: Six Bandits star shape like comet.
translations.idiomatic: Or: comet-shaped.

sentences.zh: 又曰，南方有星，望之可去地六丈，赤而數動，察之有光，其類熒惑，是謂南方之野星，名曰六賊。

translations.literal: Also: southern star six zhang from earth, red and often moving, light when examined, Sparkling Fire class—southern field star Six Bandits.
translations.idiomatic: Southern six zhang, Sparkling Fire class—Six Bandits.

sentences.zh: 出則兵起，其國亂。

translations.literal: Emergence—armies rise, state chaos.
translations.idiomatic: Emergence: armies, state chaos.

sentences.zh: 其出也，下有喪。

translations.literal: At emergence, mourning below.
translations.idiomatic: At emergence: mourning below.

sentences.zh: 出東方則南方之邦失地。

translations.literal: Emerging east—southern states lose land.
translations.idiomatic: East emergence: southern states lose land.

sentences.zh: 又曰，六賊星見，出正南，南方之星，去地可六丈，大而赤，數動有光。

translations.literal: Also: Six Bandits seen due south, southern star six zhang, large red, often moving with light.
translations.idiomatic: Due south six zhang, large red, moving with light.

sentences.zh: 三曰獄漢，一曰咸漢。

translations.literal: Three is Prison Han—one is Xian Han.
translations.idiomatic: Three: Prison Han or Xian Han.

sentences.zh: 或曰，權星散為獄漢。

translations.literal: Or: Power Star scatters into Prison Han.
translations.idiomatic: Power scatters into Prison Han.

sentences.zh: 又曰，咸漢者，五行之氣，出於北方，水之氣也。

translations.literal: Also: Xian Han—five phases' qi north, water qi.
translations.idiomatic: Xian Han: water qi north.

sentences.zh: 獄漢青中赤表，下有三彗從橫，主逐王刺王。

translations.literal: Prison Han green within red surface, below three comets crosswise—governing driving out and stabbing kings.
translations.idiomatic: Green within red, three cross comets—driving out kings.

sentences.zh: 又曰，北方有星，望之可去地六丈，大而赤，數動，察之中青黑，其類辰星，是謂北方之野星，名曰咸漢。

translations.literal: Also: northern star six zhang, large red, moving, green-black within, Chronogram class—northern field star Xian Han.
translations.idiomatic: Northern six zhang, Chronogram class—Xian Han.

sentences.zh: 出則兵起，其下有喪。

translations.literal: Emergence—armies rise, mourning below.
translations.idiomatic: Emergence: armies, mourning below.

sentences.zh: 出西方則北方之邦失地。

translations.literal: Emerging west—northern states lose land.
translations.idiomatic: West emergence: northern states lose land.

sentences.zh: 又曰，獄漢動，諸侯驚，出則陰橫。

translations.literal: Also: Prison Han moving—feudal lords alarmed, emergence then yin crosses.
translations.idiomatic: Prison Han moving: lords alarmed, yin crosses.

sentences.zh: 四曰大賁，主暴衝。

translations.literal: Four is Great Ben, governing violent rush.
translations.idiomatic: Four: Great Ben—violent rush.

sentences.zh: 五曰炤星，主滅邦。

translations.literal: Five is Bright Star, governing destroyed state.
translations.idiomatic: Five: Bright Star—destroyed state.

sentences.zh: 六曰絀流，動天下敖主伏逃。

translations.literal: Six is Frayed Flow—moving, realm proud lords hide and flee.
translations.idiomatic: Six: Frayed Flow—proud lords flee.

sentences.zh: 又曰，絀流，主自理，無所逃。

translations.literal: Also: Frayed Flow governs self-judgment, nowhere to flee.
translations.idiomatic: Frayed Flow: self-judgment, no escape.

sentences.zh: 七曰茀星，在東南，本有星，末類茀，所當之國，實受其殃。

translations.literal: Seven is Fu Star, southeast—originally has star, finally like fu grass; state struck truly suffers calamity.
translations.idiomatic: Seven: Fu Star southeast—state struck suffers.

sentences.zh: 八曰旬始。

translations.literal: Eight is Ten Start.
translations.idiomatic: Eight: Ten Start.

sentences.zh: 或曰，樞星散為旬始。

translations.literal: Or: Pivot Star scatters into Ten Start.
translations.idiomatic: Pivot scatters into Ten Start.

sentences.zh: 或曰，五星盈縮之所生也。

translations.literal: Or: born of five stars' expansion and contraction.
translations.idiomatic: Born of five stars' expansion and contraction.

sentences.zh: 亦曰，旬始妖氣。

translations.literal: Also: Ten Start baleful qi.
translations.idiomatic: Ten Start baleful qi.

sentences.zh: 又曰，旬始蚩尤也。

translations.literal: Also: Ten Start is Chiyou.
translations.idiomatic: Ten Start is Chiyou.

sentences.zh: 又曰，旬始出於北斗旁，狀如雄雞。

translations.literal: Also: Ten Start emerges beside Northern Dipper, shaped like rooster.
translations.idiomatic: Emerges beside Dipper like rooster.

sentences.zh: 其怒青黑，象伏鱉。

translations.literal: Its anger green-black, image crouching turtle.
translations.idiomatic: Anger green-black like crouching turtle.

sentences.zh: 又曰，黃彗分為旬始。

translations.literal: Also: yellow comet divides into Ten Start.
translations.idiomatic: Yellow comet divides into Ten Start.

sentences.zh: 旬始者，今起也。

translations.literal: Ten Start means now rising.
translations.idiomatic: Ten Start: now rising.

sentences.zh: 狀如雄雞，土含陽，以交白接，精象雞，故以為立主之題。

translations.literal: Shaped like rooster, earth containing yang, white intersecting—essence like chicken—therefore taken as establishing lord theme.
translations.idiomatic: Rooster-shaped, earth-yang—establishing lord.

sentences.zh: 期十年，聖人起代。

translations.literal: Term ten years—sage rises in succession.
translations.idiomatic: Ten years: sage succeeds.

sentences.zh: 又曰，旬始主爭兵，主亂，主招橫。

translations.literal: Also: Ten Start governs contending armies, chaos, summoning violence.
translations.idiomatic: Ten Start: contending armies, chaos, violence.

sentences.zh: 又曰，旬始照，其下必有滅王。

translations.literal: Also: Ten Start shining—below certainly destroyed king.
translations.idiomatic: Ten Start shining: destroyed king below.

sentences.zh: 五奸爭作，暴骨積骸，以子續食。

translations.literal: Five wickedness contend, exposed bones piled, children continue eating.
translations.idiomatic: Five wickedness, piled bones, children eating.

sentences.zh: 見則臣亂兵作，諸侯為虐。

translations.literal: Seen—minister chaos, armies rise, lords are cruel.
translations.idiomatic: Seen: minister chaos, cruel lords.

sentences.zh: 又曰，常以戊戌日，視五車及天軍天庫中有奇怪，曰旬始。

translations.literal: Also: regularly on wuxu day observe Five Chariots and Celestial Army Storehouse for strangeness—called Ten Start.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day observe Five Chariots for Ten Start.

sentences.zh: 狀如鳥有喙，而見者則兵大起，攻戰當其首者破死。

translations.literal: Shaped like bird with beak—seer means armies rise greatly, attacking the head means broken death.
translations.idiomatic: Bird-beak shape: armies; striking head: death.

sentences.zh: 又曰，出見北斗，聖人受命，天子壽，王者有福。

translations.literal: Also: emerging seen at Northern Dipper—sage receives mandate, Son of Heaven long-lived, king has fortune.
translations.idiomatic: At Dipper: sage mandate, long life, fortune.

sentences.zh: 九曰擊咎，出，臣下主。

translations.literal: Nine is Strike Blame, emerging—subordinates master.
translations.idiomatic: Nine: Strike Blame—subordinates master.

sentences.zh: 一曰，臣禁主，主大兵。

translations.literal: One says: ministers restrain lord, lord great armies.
translations.idiomatic: Ministers restrain lord, great armies.

sentences.zh: 又曰，土精，斗七星之域，以長四方，司空之位，有謀反恣虐者，占如上。

translations.literal: Also: earth essence, Dipper seven lodges' domain, lengthening four quarters, Minister of Works position—rebellion and cruelty as above.
translations.idiomatic: Earth essence, Dipper domain—rebellion as above.

sentences.zh: 太白之精，散為天杵、天柎、伏靈、大敗、司奸、天狗、天殘、卒起。

translations.literal: Great White's essence scatters into Celestial Pestle, Celestial Shaft, Hidden Spirit, Great Defeat, Si Jian, Celestial Dog, Celestial Ruin, Sudden Rise.
translations.idiomatic: Great White essence: Pestle, Shaft, Hidden Spirit, Great Defeat, Si Jian, Dog, Ruin, Sudden Rise.

sentences.zh: 一曰天杵，主䍧羊。

translations.literal: One is Celestial Pestle, governing ram.
translations.idiomatic: One: Celestial Pestle—ram.

sentences.zh: 二曰天柎，主擊殃。

translations.literal: Two is Celestial Shaft, governing strike calamity.
translations.idiomatic: Two: Celestial Shaft—strike calamity.

sentences.zh: 三曰伏靈，主領讒。

translations.literal: Three is Hidden Spirit, governing receiving slander.
translations.idiomatic: Three: Hidden Spirit—slander.

sentences.zh: 伏靈出，天下亂複人。

translations.literal: Hidden Spirit emerging—realm chaos and repeated people.
translations.idiomatic: Hidden Spirit: chaos and repeated people.

sentences.zh: 四曰大敗，主鬭衝。

translations.literal: Four is Great Defeat, governing battle rush.
translations.idiomatic: Four: Great Defeat—battle rush.

sentences.zh: 或曰，大敗出，擊咎謀。

translations.literal: Or: Great Defeat emerging—Strike Blame plots.
translations.idiomatic: Great Defeat: Strike Blame plots.

sentences.zh: 五曰司奸，主見妖。

translations.literal: Five is Si Jian, governing appearing wickedness.
translations.idiomatic: Five: Si Jian—appearing wickedness.

sentences.zh: 六曰天狗。

translations.literal: Six is Celestial Dog.
translations.idiomatic: Six: Celestial Dog.

sentences.zh: 亦曰，五星氣合之變，出西南，金火氣合，名曰天狗。

translations.literal: Also: five stars' qi combined transformation, emerging southwest, metal-fire qi combined—called Celestial Dog.
translations.idiomatic: Southwest metal-fire combined: Celestial Dog.

sentences.zh: 或曰，天狗星有毛，旁有短彗，下有如狗形者，主徵兵，主討賊。

translations.literal: Or: Celestial Dog star has hair, short comet beside, below dog shape—governing conscripting armies, governing attacking bandits.
translations.idiomatic: Hair, short comet, dog shape—armies and bandits.

sentences.zh: 亦曰，天狗流，五將鬭。

translations.literal: Also: Celestial Dog flow—five generals battle.
translations.idiomatic: Dog flow: five generals battle.

sentences.zh: 又曰，西北方有星，長三丈，而出水金氣交，名曰天狗。

translations.literal: Also: northwest star three zhang, water-metal qi crossing—called Celestial Dog.
translations.idiomatic: Northwest three zhang, water-metal crossing: Dog.

sentences.zh: 亦曰，西北三星，大而白，名曰天狗。

translations.literal: Also: northwest three stars, large white—called Celestial Dog.
translations.idiomatic: Northwest three large white: Dog.

sentences.zh: 見則大兵起，天下饑，人相食。

translations.literal: Seen—great armies rise, realm famine, people eat one another.
translations.idiomatic: Seen: armies, famine, cannibalism.

sentences.zh: 又曰，天狗所下之處，必有大戰，破軍殺將，伏屍流血，天狗食之。

translations.literal: Also: where Celestial Dog descends—certainly great battle, broken armies, slain generals, corpses, blood—Celestial Dog eats.
translations.idiomatic: Where Dog descends: battle, corpses, blood—Dog eats.

sentences.zh: 皆期一年，中二年，遠三年，各以其所下之國，以占吉凶。

translations.literal: All term one year, middle two years, far three years—each by descended state for fortune and misfortune.
translations.idiomatic: Term one to three years by descended state.

sentences.zh: 後流星內天狗，名同，占狀小異。

translations.literal: Later among shooting stars there is Celestial Dog—same name, slightly different omen form.
translations.idiomatic: Later shooting stars also have Dog—slightly different.

sentences.zh: 七曰天殘，主貪殘。

translations.literal: Seven is Celestial Ruin, governing greedy cruelty.
translations.idiomatic: Seven: Celestial Ruin—greedy cruelty.

sentences.zh: 八曰卒起。

translations.literal: Eight is Sudden Rise.
translations.idiomatic: Eight: Sudden Rise.

sentences.zh: 卒起見，禍無時，諸變有萌，臣運柄。

translations.literal: Sudden Rise seen—calamity without time, all changes have buds, ministers wield power.
translations.idiomatic: Sudden Rise: untimed calamity, ministers wield power.

sentences.zh: 又曰，少陰之精，大司馬之類，白獸七宿之域，有謀反，若恣虐為害，主失秋政者，期如上占，禍亦應之。

translations.literal: Also: lesser yin essence, Grand Marshal class, white beast seven lodges—rebellion, cruelty, lost autumn government as above.
translations.idiomatic: Lesser yin, Marshal class—lost autumn as above.

sentences.zh: 辰星之精，散為枉矢、破女、拂樞、滅寶、繞廷、驚理、大奮祀。

translations.literal: Chronogram Star's essence scatters into Crooked Arrow, Broken Woman, Brush Pivot, Destroyed Treasure, Coiling Court, Alarm Reason, Great Exalted Sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: Chronogram essence: Crooked Arrow, Broken Woman, Brush Pivot, Destroyed Treasure, Coiling Court, Alarm Reason, Great Exalted Sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 一曰枉矢。

translations.literal: One is Crooked Arrow.
translations.idiomatic: One: Crooked Arrow.

sentences.zh: 或曰，填星之變為枉矢。

translations.literal: Or: Fill Star's transformation becomes Crooked Arrow.
translations.idiomatic: Fill becomes Crooked Arrow.

sentences.zh: 又曰，機星散為枉矢。

translations.literal: Or: Pivot Star scatters into Crooked Arrow.
translations.idiomatic: Pivot scatters into Crooked Arrow.

sentences.zh: 亦曰，枉矢，五星盈縮之所生也，弓弩之像也。

translations.literal: Also: Crooked Arrow—born of five stars' expansion and contraction, image of bow and crossbow.
translations.idiomatic: Born of five stars, bow image.

sentences.zh: 類大流星，色蒼黑，蛇行，望之如有毛目，長數匹，著天。

translations.literal: Like large shooting star, dark green color, snake travel, seen as if with hair and eyes, several pi long, attached to heaven.
translations.idiomatic: Large dark green snake-like star with hair-eyes, several pi.

sentences.zh: 主反萌，主射愚。

translations.literal: Governing rebellion budding, governing shooting the foolish.
translations.idiomatic: Rebellion budding, shooting the foolish.

sentences.zh: 又曰，黑彗分為枉矢。

translations.literal: Also: black comet divides into Crooked Arrow.
translations.idiomatic: Black comet divides into Crooked Arrow.

sentences.zh: 枉矢者，射是也。

translations.literal: Crooked Arrow means shooting.
translations.idiomatic: Crooked Arrow means shooting.

sentences.zh: 枉矢見，謀反之兵合，射所誅，亦為以亂伐亂。

translations.literal: Crooked Arrow seen—rebellion armies combine, shooting the executed, also using chaos to attack chaos.
translations.idiomatic: Crooked Arrow: rebellion armies, shooting execution.

sentences.zh: 又曰，人君暴專己，則有枉矢動。

translations.literal: Also: human lord violent and self-willed—Crooked Arrow moves.
translations.idiomatic: Violent lord: Crooked Arrow moves.

sentences.zh: 亦曰，枉矢類流星，望之有尾目，長可一匹布，皎皎著天。

translations.literal: Also: Crooked Arrow like shooting star, seen with tail-eyes, one bolt-cloth long, bright attached to heaven.
translations.idiomatic: Like shooting star with tail-eyes, one bolt long.

sentences.zh: 見則大兵起，大將出，弓弩用，期三年。

translations.literal: Seen—great armies rise, great general emerges, bows and crossbows used, term three years.
translations.idiomatic: Seen: armies, general, bows, three years.

sentences.zh: 曰，枉矢所觸，天下之所伐，射滅之象也。

translations.literal: Crooked Arrow's touch—what under Heaven is attacked, image of shooting destruction.
translations.idiomatic: Crooked Arrow's touch: shooting destruction.

sentences.zh: 二曰破女。

translations.literal: Two is Broken Woman.
translations.idiomatic: Two: Broken Woman.

sentences.zh: 破女若見，君臣皆誅，主勝之符。

translations.literal: Broken Woman if seen—lord and ministers all executed, lord-victory token.
translations.idiomatic: Broken Woman: all executed, lord-victory token.

sentences.zh: 三曰拂樞。

translations.literal: Three is Brush Pivot.
translations.idiomatic: Three: Brush Pivot.

sentences.zh: 拂樞動亂，駭擾無調時。

translations.literal: Brush Pivot moving chaos—alarm and disturbance without regulated time.
translations.idiomatic: Brush Pivot: chaos without time.

sentences.zh: 又曰，拂樞主制時。

translations.literal: Also: Brush Pivot governs regulating time.
translations.idiomatic: Also: governs regulating time.

sentences.zh: 四曰滅寶。

translations.literal: Four is Destroyed Treasure.
translations.idiomatic: Four: Destroyed Treasure.

sentences.zh: 滅寶起，相得之。

translations.literal: Destroyed Treasure rising—mutual obtaining.
translations.idiomatic: Destroyed Treasure: mutual obtaining.

sentences.zh: 又曰，滅寶主伐之。

translations.literal: Also: Destroyed Treasure governs attacking.
translations.idiomatic: Also: governs attacking.

sentences.zh: 五曰繞廷。

translations.literal: Five is Coiling Court.
translations.idiomatic: Five: Coiling Court.

sentences.zh: 繞廷主亂孳。

translations.literal: Coiling Court governs chaotic breeding.
translations.idiomatic: Coiling Court: chaotic breeding.

sentences.zh: 六曰驚理。

translations.literal: Six is Alarm Reason.
translations.idiomatic: Six: Alarm Reason.

sentences.zh: 驚理主相署。

translations.literal: Alarm Reason governs mutual appointment.
translations.idiomatic: Alarm Reason: mutual appointment.

sentences.zh: 七曰大奮祀。

translations.literal: Seven is Great Exalted Sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: Seven: Great Exalted Sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 大奮祀主招邪。

translations.literal: Great Exalted Sacrifice governs summoning wickedness.
translations.idiomatic: Great Exalted Sacrifice: summoning wickedness.

sentences.zh: 或曰，大奮祀出，主安之。

translations.literal: Or: Great Exalted Sacrifice emerging—lord is secure.
translations.idiomatic: Or: emerging—lord secure.

sentences.zh: 太陰之精，玄武七宿之域，有謀反，若恣虐為害，主失冬政者，期如上占，禍亦應之。

translations.literal: Great Yin essence, dark warrior seven lodges—rebellion, cruelty, lost winter government as above.
translations.idiomatic: Great Yin, dark warrior domain—lost winter as above.

sentences.zh: 又曰，五精潛潭，皆以類逆所犯，行失時指，下臣承類者，乘而害之，皆滅亡之征也。

translations.literal: Also: five essences hidden deep—all by category of what they violate, travel losing timely direction, subordinates of corresponding class ride and harm— all signs of destruction.
translations.idiomatic: Five essences hidden deep—violation brings destruction.

sentences.zh: 入天子宿，主滅，諸侯五百謀。

translations.literal: Entering Son of Heaven's lodge—lord destroyed, five hundred feudal lords plot.
translations.idiomatic: Entering royal lodge: lord destroyed, lords plot.

sentences.zh: 雜妖一曰天鋒。

translations.literal: Miscellaneous baleful one is Celestial Edge.
translations.idiomatic: Miscellaneous baleful one: Celestial Edge.

sentences.zh: 天鋒，彗象矛鋒者也，主從橫。

translations.literal: Celestial Edge—comet image of spear edge, governing unrestrained violence.
translations.idiomatic: Celestial Edge: spear-edge comet, unrestrained violence.

sentences.zh: 天下從橫，則天鋒星見。

translations.literal: Realm unrestrained—Celestial Edge star appears.
translations.idiomatic: Unrestrained realm: Celestial Edge appears.

sentences.zh: 二曰燭星，狀如太白，其出也不行，見則不久而滅。

translations.literal: Two is Candle Star, like Great White, not moving when emerging, seen not long then extinguished.
translations.idiomatic: Two: Candle Star like Great White, brief appearance.

sentences.zh: 或曰，主星上有三彗上出。

translations.literal: Or: above lord star three comets emerge upward.
translations.idiomatic: Or: three comets above lord star.

sentences.zh: 燭星所出邑反。

translations.literal: Candle Star's emerged town reverses.
translations.idiomatic: Candle Star's town reverses.

sentences.zh: 又曰，燭星所燭者城邑亂。

translations.literal: Also: where Candle Star illuminates—city chaos.
translations.idiomatic: Candle illumination: city chaos.

sentences.zh: 又曰，燭星所出，有大盜不成。

translations.literal: Also: Candle Star emerging—great bandit not accomplished.
translations.idiomatic: Candle emerging: great bandit fails.

sentences.zh: 三曰蓬星，一名王星，狀如夜火之光，多即至四五，少即一二。

translations.literal: Three is Peng Star, also called Wang Star—like night fire light, many then four-five, few then one-two.
translations.idiomatic: Three: Peng Star like night fire, one to five.

sentences.zh: 亦曰，蓬星在西南，修數丈，左右銳，出而易處。

translations.literal: Also: Peng Star southwest, several zhang, left-right sharp, emerging and easily shifting.
translations.idiomatic: Southwest several zhang, sharp, easily shifting.

sentences.zh: 又曰，有星，其色黃白，方不過三尺，名曰蓬星。

translations.literal: Also: star yellow-white, square not exceeding three chi—called Peng Star.
translations.idiomatic: Yellow-white under three chi: Peng Star.

sentences.zh: 又曰，蓬星狀如粉絮，見則天下道術士當有出者，布衣之士貴，天下太平，五穀成。

translations.literal: Also: Peng Star like powder fluff—seen means Way masters emerge, plain-cloth scholars honored, realm peaceful, five grains succeed.
translations.idiomatic: Like powder fluff: Way masters, honored scholars, peace.

sentences.zh: 又曰，蓬星出北斗，諸侯有奪地，以地亡，有兵起。

translations.literal: Also: Peng Star emerging at Northern Dipper—feudal lords seize land, lose land by territory, armies rise.
translations.idiomatic: At Dipper: lords seize land, armies.

sentences.zh: 星所居者，期不出三年。

translations.literal: Where star lodges—term within three years.
translations.idiomatic: Lodging: term within three years.

sentences.zh: 又曰，蓬星出太微中，天子立王。

translations.literal: Also: Peng Star emerging in Supreme Subtlety—Son of Heaven establishes king.
translations.idiomatic: In Supreme Subtlety: Son of Heaven establishes king.

sentences.zh: 四曰長庚，狀如一匹布著天。

translations.literal: Four is Long Geng, shaped like one bolt cloth attached to heaven.
translations.idiomatic: Four: Long Geng like bolt cloth on heaven.

sentences.zh: 見則兵起。

translations.literal: Seen—armies rise.
translations.idiomatic: Seen: armies.

sentences.zh: 五曰四填，星出四隅，去地六丈餘。

translations.literal: Five is Four Fill, stars emerging four corners, six-plus zhang from earth.
translations.idiomatic: Five: Four Fill at four corners, six-plus zhang.

sentences.zh: 或曰，四填去地可四丈。

translations.literal: Or: Four Fill four zhang from earth.
translations.idiomatic: Or: four zhang from earth.

sentences.zh: 或曰，四填星大而赤，去地二丈，當以夜半時出。

translations.literal: Or: Four Fill star large red, two zhang from earth, should emerge at midnight.
translations.idiomatic: Large red two zhang at midnight.

sentences.zh: 四填星見，十月而兵起。

translations.literal: Four Fill seen—armies rise in tenth month.
translations.idiomatic: Four Fill: armies in tenth month.

sentences.zh: 又曰，四填星見四隅，皆為兵起其下。

translations.literal: Also: Four Fill seen at four corners—all armies rise below.
translations.idiomatic: At four corners: armies below.

sentences.zh: 六曰地維臧光。

translations.literal: Six is Earth Net Hidden Light.
translations.idiomatic: Six: Earth Net Hidden Light.

sentences.zh: 地維臧光者，五行之氣，出於四季土之氣也。

translations.literal: Earth Net Hidden Light—five phases' qi, emerging from four seasons' earth qi.
translations.idiomatic: Earth Net Hidden Light: four seasons' earth qi.

sentences.zh: 又曰，有星出，大而赤，去地二三丈，如月，始出謂之地維臧光。

translations.literal: Also: star emerges large red, two-three zhang from earth, like moon—at first emergence called Earth Net Hidden Light.
translations.idiomatic: Large red two-three zhang like moon: Earth Net Hidden Light.

sentences.zh: 四隅有星，望之可去地四丈，而赤黃搖動，其類填星，是謂中央之野星，出於四隅，名曰地維臧光。

translations.literal: Stars at four corners, seen four zhang from earth, red-yellow trembling, Fill Star class—central field star, emerging four corners, called Earth Net Hidden Light.
translations.idiomatic: Four-corner red-yellow Fill-class stars: Earth Net Hidden Light.

sentences.zh: 出東北隅，天下大水。

translations.literal: Emerging northeast corner—great flood under Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: Northeast: great flood.

sentences.zh: 出東南隅，天下大旱。

translations.literal: Emerging southeast corner—great drought under Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: Southeast: great drought.

sentences.zh: 出西南隅，則有兵起。

translations.literal: Emerging southwest corner—armies rise.
translations.idiomatic: Southwest: armies.

sentences.zh: 出西北隅，則天下亂，兵大起。

translations.literal: Emerging northwest corner—realm chaos, armies rise greatly.
translations.idiomatic: Northwest: chaos and great armies.

sentences.zh: 又曰，地維臧光見，下有亂者亡，有德者昌。

translations.literal: Also: Earth Net Hidden Light seen—below chaotic ones perish, virtuous ones flourish.
translations.idiomatic: Seen: chaotic perish, virtuous flourish.

sentences.zh: 七曰女帛。

translations.literal: Seven is Woman Silk.
translations.idiomatic: Seven: Woman Silk.

sentences.zh: 女帛者，五星氣合變，出東北，水木氣合也。

translations.literal: Woman Silk—five stars' qi combined transformation, emerging northeast, water-wood qi combined.
translations.idiomatic: Northeast water-wood combined: Woman Silk.

sentences.zh: 又曰，東北有星，長三丈而出，名曰女帛，見則天下兵起，若有大喪。

translations.literal: Also: northeast star three zhang emerging—called Woman Silk; seen—armies rise, or great mourning.
translations.idiomatic: Northeast three zhang: Woman Silk—armies or mourning.

sentences.zh: 又東北有大星出，名曰女帛，見則天下有大喪。

translations.literal: Also northeast large star emerging—called Woman Silk; seen—great mourning under Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: Large northeast star: great mourning.

sentences.zh: 八曰盜星。

translations.literal: Eight is Bandit Star.
translations.idiomatic: Eight: Bandit Star.

sentences.zh: 盜星者，五星氣合之變，出東南，火木氣合也。

translations.literal: Bandit Star—five stars' qi combined transformation, emerging southeast, fire-wood qi combined.
translations.idiomatic: Southeast fire-wood combined: Bandit Star.

sentences.zh: 又曰，東南有星，長三丈而出，名曰盜星，見則天下有大盜，多寇賊。

translations.literal: Also: southeast star three zhang emerging—called Bandit Star; seen—great bandit under Heaven, many robbers.
translations.idiomatic: Southeast three zhang: great bandit, many robbers.

sentences.zh: 九曰積陵。

translations.literal: Nine is Accumulated Mound.
translations.idiomatic: Nine: Accumulated Mound.

sentences.zh: 積陵者，五星氣合之變，出西北，金水氣合也。

translations.literal: Accumulated Mound—five stars' qi combined transformation, emerging northwest, metal-water qi combined.
translations.idiomatic: Northwest metal-water combined: Accumulated Mound.

sentences.zh: 又曰，西南有星，長三丈，名曰積陵，見則天下隕霜，兵大起，五穀不成，人饑。

translations.literal: Also: southwest star three zhang—called Accumulated Mound; seen—frost falls under Heaven, armies rise greatly, five grains fail, people hunger.
translations.idiomatic: Southwest three zhang: frost, armies, failed grain, hunger.

sentences.zh: 十曰端星。

translations.literal: Ten is Terminal Star.
translations.idiomatic: Ten: Terminal Star.

sentences.zh: 端星者，五星氣合之變，出與金木水火合於四隅。

translations.literal: Terminal Star—five stars' qi combined transformation, emerging with metal-wood-fire-water combined at four corners.
translations.idiomatic: Four-corner metal-wood-fire-water combined: Terminal Star.

sentences.zh: 又四隅有星，大而赤，察之中黃，數動，長可四丈。

translations.literal: Also four-corner star large red, green within when examined, often moving, four zhang long.
translations.idiomatic: Four-corner large red, green within, moving, four zhang.

sentences.zh: 此土之氣，效於四季，名曰四隅端星，所出，兵大起。

translations.literal: This earth qi, effecting four seasons—called Four-Corner Terminal Star; emergence—armies rise greatly.
translations.idiomatic: Four seasons' earth qi—Four-Corner Terminal: great armies.

sentences.zh: 十一曰昏昌。

translations.literal: Eleven is Dusk Prosperity.
translations.idiomatic: Eleven: Dusk Prosperity.

sentences.zh: 有星出西北，氣青赤以環之，中赤外青，名曰昏昌，見則天下兵起，國易政。

translations.literal: Star emerges northwest, green-red qi encircling it, red within green without—called Dusk Prosperity; seen—armies rise, state changes government.
translations.idiomatic: Northwest green-red encircled: Dusk Prosperity—armies, changed government.

sentences.zh: 先起者昌，後起者亡。

translations.literal: First rising flourishes; later rising perishes.
translations.idiomatic: First rising flourishes; later perishes.

sentences.zh: 高十丈，亂一年。

translations.literal: Ten zhang high—chaos one year.
translations.idiomatic: Ten zhang: one year chaos.

sentences.zh: 高二十丈，亂二年。

translations.literal: Twenty zhang—chaos two years.
translations.idiomatic: Twenty zhang: two years.

sentences.zh: 高三十丈，亂三年。

translations.literal: Thirty zhang—chaos three years.
translations.idiomatic: Thirty zhang: three years.

sentences.zh: 十二曰莘星。

translations.literal: Twelve is Shen Star.
translations.idiomatic: Twelve: Shen Star.

sentences.zh: 有星出西北，狀如有環二，名山勤。

translations.literal: Star emerges northwest, shaped as if two rings—called Mountain Diligence.
translations.idiomatic: Northwest two rings: Mountain Diligence.

sentences.zh: 一星見則諸侯有失地，西北國。

translations.literal: One star seen—feudal lords lose land, northwest states.
translations.idiomatic: One star: northwest lords lose land.

sentences.zh: 十三曰白星。

translations.literal: Thirteen is White Star.
translations.idiomatic: Thirteen: White Star.

sentences.zh: 有如星非星，狀如削瓜，有勝兵，名曰白星。

translations.literal: Like star not star, shaped like sliced melon, has victorious armies—called White Star.
translations.idiomatic: Not-star like sliced melon with victorious armies: White Star.

sentences.zh: 白星出，為男喪。

translations.literal: White Star emerging—male mourning.
translations.idiomatic: White Star: male mourning.

sentences.zh: 十四曰菟昌。

translations.literal: Fourteen is Tu Chang.
translations.idiomatic: Fourteen: Tu Chang.

sentences.zh: 西北菟昌之星，有赤青環之，有殃，有青為水。

translations.literal: Northwest Tu Chang star, red-green encircled, calamity, green means water.
translations.idiomatic: Northwest Tu Chang red-green encircled: calamity, green water.

sentences.zh: 此星見，則天下改易。

translations.literal: This star seen—realm transformed.
translations.idiomatic: Seen: realm transformed.

sentences.zh: 十五曰格澤，狀如炎火。

translations.literal: Fifteen is Ge Ze, shaped like blazing fire.
translations.idiomatic: Fifteen: Ge Ze like blazing fire.

sentences.zh: 又曰，格澤星也，上黃下白，從地而上，下大上銳，見則不種而獲。

translations.literal: Also: Ge Ze star, yellow above white below, from earth upward, large below sharp above—seen then harvest without planting.
translations.idiomatic: Yellow-white from earth, harvest without planting.

sentences.zh: 又曰，不有土功，必有大客鄰國來者，期一年、二年。

translations.literal: Also: if not earthwork, certainly great guest from neighboring state, term one-two years.
translations.idiomatic: Or: neighboring guest, one-two years.

sentences.zh: 又曰，格澤氣赤如火，炎炎中天，上下同色，東西糸亙天，若於南北，長可四五裡。

translations.literal: Also: Ge Ze qi red like fire, blazing mid-heaven, same color above-below, east-west spanning heaven, if north-south four-five li long.
translations.idiomatic: Red fire spanning heaven four-five li.

sentences.zh: 此熒惑之變，見則兵起，其下伏屍流血，期三年。

translations.literal: This Sparkling Fire transformation—seen armies rise, below corpses and blood, term three years.
translations.idiomatic: Sparkling Fire transformation: armies, blood, three years.

sentences.zh: 十六曰歸邪，狀如星非星，如雲非雲。

translations.literal: Sixteen is Return Wickedness, shaped like star not star, like cloud not cloud.
translations.idiomatic: Sixteen: Return Wickedness—not star, not cloud.

sentences.zh: 或曰，有兩赤彗上向，上有蓋狀如氣，下連星。

translations.literal: Or: two red comets upward, above canopy-like qi, below linked stars.
translations.idiomatic: Two red comets upward with canopy qi.

sentences.zh: 或曰，見必有歸國者。

translations.literal: Or: seen—certainly one returning to state.
translations.idiomatic: Seen: one returning to state.

sentences.zh: 十七曰濛星，夜有赤氣如牙旗，長短四面，西南最多。

translations.literal: Seventeen is Mist Star—at night red qi like banner teeth, long and short four directions, most in southwest.
translations.idiomatic: Seventeen: Mist Star—banner-tooth red qi, most southwest.

sentences.zh: 又曰刀星，亂之象。

translations.literal: Also called Blade Star—image of chaos.
translations.idiomatic: Also Blade Star—chaos image.

sentences.zh: 又曰，遍天薄雲，四方生赤黃氣，長三尺，乍見乍沒，尋皆消滅。

translations.literal: Also: thin clouds across heaven, four directions produce red-yellow qi three chi, appearing and disappearing, all soon vanish.
translations.idiomatic: Thin clouds, red-yellow qi three chi, vanishing.

sentences.zh: 又曰，刀星見，天下有兵，戰鬭流血。

translations.literal: Also: Blade Star seen—realm has armies, battle flowing blood.
translations.idiomatic: Blade Star: armies and blood.

sentences.zh: 或曰，遍天薄雲，四方合有八氣，蒼白色，長三尺，乍見乍沒。

translations.literal: Or: thin clouds across heaven, four directions together eight qi, dark white three chi, appearing and disappearing.
translations.idiomatic: Eight dark-white qi three chi, appearing and disappearing.

sentences.zh: 漢京房著《風角書》，有《集星章》，所載妖星，皆見於月旁，互有五色方雲，以五寅日見，各五星所生雲。

translations.literal: Han Jing Fang authored Wind Angle Book with Collected Stars Chapter—the baleful stars recorded all appear beside the moon, each with five-color directional clouds, seen on five yin days, each five stars' generated clouds.
translations.idiomatic: Han Jing Fang's Collected Stars Chapter: baleful stars beside moon with five-color clouds.

sentences.zh: 天槍星生箕宿中，天根星生尾宿中，天荊星生心宿中，真若星生房宿中，天扌袁星生氐宿中，天樓星生亢宿中，天垣星生左角宿中，皆歲星所生也。

translations.literal: Celestial Spear Star born in Winnowing Basket lodge, Celestial Root in Tail, Celestial Thorn in Heart, Zhen Ruo in Chamber, Celestial Yuan in Root, Celestial Tower in Neck, Celestial Rampart in left Horn—all Year Star generated.
translations.idiomatic: Spear, Root, Thorn, Ruo, Yuan, Tower, Rampart—Year Star generated.

sentences.zh: 見以甲寅日，其星咸有兩青方在其旁。

translations.literal: Seen on jiayin day—all stars have two green方 beside them.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day: two green方 beside each.

sentences.zh: 天陰星生軫宿中，晉若星生翼宿中，官張星生張宿中，天惑星生七宿中，天雀星生柳宿中，赤若星生鬼宿中，蚩尤星生井宿中，皆熒惑之所生也。

translations.literal: Celestial Yin born in Chariot, Jin Ruo in Wings, Official Zhang in Extended Net, Celestial Confusion in Seven Stars, Celestial Sparrow in Willow, Red Ruo in Ghost, Chiyou in Well—all Sparkling Fire generated.
translations.idiomatic: Yin, Ruo, Zhang, Confusion, Sparrow, Red Ruo, Chiyou—Sparkling Fire generated.

sentences.zh: 出在丙寅日，有兩赤方在其旁。

translations.literal: Emerging on bingyin day—two red方 beside them.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day: two red方 beside each.

sentences.zh: 天上、天伐、從星、天樞、天翟、天沸、荊彗，皆鎮星之所生也。

translations.literal: Heaven Up, Heaven Punishment, Follow Star, Celestial Pivot, Celestial Di, Heaven Boil, Thorn Comet—all Fill Star generated.
translations.idiomatic: Up, Punishment, Follow, Pivot, Di, Boil, Comet—Fill generated.

sentences.zh: 出在戊寅日，有兩黃方在其旁。

translations.literal: Emerging on wuyin day—two yellow方 beside them.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day: two yellow方 beside each.

sentences.zh: 若星生參宿中，帚星生觜宿中，若彗星生畢宿中，竹彗星生昴宿中，牆星生胃宿中，榬星生婁宿中，白雚星生奎宿中，皆太白之所生也。

translations.literal: Ruo Star born in Three Stars, Broom in Turtle Beak, Ruo Comet in Net, Bamboo Comet in Hairy Head, Wall in Stomach, Yuan in Bond, White Reed in Strider—all Great White generated.
translations.idiomatic: Ruo, Broom, Comet, Bamboo, Wall, Yuan, Reed—Great White generated.

sentences.zh: 出在庚寅日，有兩白方在其旁。

translations.literal: Emerging on gengyin day—two white方 beside them.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day: two white方 beside each.

sentences.zh: 天美星生壁宿中，天毚星生室宿中，天杜星生危宿中，天麻星生虛宿中，天林星生女宿中，天高星生牛宿中，端下星生斗宿中，皆辰星之所生也。

translations.literal: Heaven Beauty born in Wall, Heaven Caterpillar in Encampment, Heaven Du in Rooftop, Heaven Hemp in Emptiness, Heaven Forest in Weaving Maid, Heaven Height in Ox, Terminal Below in Dipper—all Chronogram generated.
translations.idiomatic: Beauty, Caterpillar, Du, Hemp, Forest, Height, Terminal Below—Chronogram generated.

sentences.zh: 出以壬寅日，有兩黑方在其旁。

translations.literal: Emerging on renyin day—two black方 beside them.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day: two black方 beside each.

sentences.zh: 已前三十五星，即五行氣所生，皆出月左右方氣之中，各在其所生星將出不出日數期候之。

translations.literal: The preceding thirty-five stars—five phases' qi generated—all emerge in moon-left-right方 qi, each at its generated star's days before emergence take omens.
translations.idiomatic: Thirty-five stars from five phases beside moon—omen before emergence.

sentences.zh: 當其未出之前而見，見則有水旱兵喪饑亂，所指亡國失地，王死，破軍殺將。

translations.literal: If seen before not yet emerging—seen means flood, drought, armies, mourning, famine, chaos; pointed direction loses state and land, king dies, broken armies and slain generals.
translations.idiomatic: Seen before emergence: disaster, lost state, dead king.

sentences.zh: 客星客星者，周伯、老子、王蓬絮、國皇、溫星，凡五星，皆客星也。

translations.literal: Guest stars—Zhou Bo, Laozi, Wang Pengxu, State Sovereign, Warm Star—generally five stars, all guest stars.
translations.idiomatic: Guest stars: Zhou Bo, Laozi, Wang Pengxu, State Sovereign, Warm Star.

sentences.zh: 行諸列舍，十二國分野，各在其所臨之邦，所守之宿，以占吉凶。

translations.literal: Traveling the lodges—twelve states' field divisions, each in the state it faces, guarding the lodge—take omens for fortune and misfortune.
translations.idiomatic: Traveling lodges—twelve states' omens by facing and guarding.

sentences.zh: 周伯，大而色黃，煌煌然。

translations.literal: Zhou Bo—large and yellow, brilliant.
translations.idiomatic: Zhou Bo: large yellow brilliant.

sentences.zh: 見其國兵起，若有喪，天下饑，眾庶流亡去其鄉。

translations.literal: State where seen—armies rise, or mourning, realm famine, multitudes wander exile from their villages.
translations.idiomatic: Seen state: armies, mourning, famine, exile.

sentences.zh: 瑞星中名狀與此同，而占異。

translations.literal: Auspicious star names and forms same as this but omens differ.
translations.idiomatic: Auspicious stars same name, different omens.

sentences.zh: 老子，明大，色白，淳淳然。

translations.literal: Laozi—bright large, white, pure and thick.
translations.idiomatic: Laozi: bright large white pure.

sentences.zh: 所出之國，為饑，為凶，為善，為惡，為喜，為怒。

translations.literal: State where emerges—famine, calamity, good, evil, joy, anger.
translations.idiomatic: Emerging state: famine, good, evil, joy, anger.

sentences.zh: 常出見則兵大起，人主有憂。

translations.literal: Regularly emerging—armies rise greatly, human lord grieves.
translations.idiomatic: Regular emergence: armies, lord grieves.

sentences.zh: 王者以赦除咎則災消。

translations.literal: King amnesty removes blame then calamity disappears.
translations.idiomatic: Royal amnesty removes calamity.

sentences.zh: 王蓬絮，狀如粉絮，拂拂然。

translations.literal: Wang Pengxu—shaped like powder fluff, fluttering.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Pengxu: powder fluff fluttering.

sentences.zh: 見則其國兵起，若有喪，白衣之會，其邦饑亡。

translations.literal: Seen—state armies rise, or mourning, white-clad assembly, state famine and perish.
translations.idiomatic: Seen: armies, mourning, white assembly, famine.

sentences.zh: 又曰，王蓬絮，星色青而熒熒然。

translations.literal: Also: Wang Pengxu—star color green and glowing.
translations.idiomatic: Also green glowing.

sentences.zh: 所見之國，風雨不如節，焦旱，物不生，五穀不成登，蝗蟲多。

translations.literal: State where seen—wind and rain not by season, scorching drought, things not born, five grains not ripe, locusts many.
translations.idiomatic: Seen state: drought, failed grain, locusts.

sentences.zh: 國皇星，出而大，其色黃白，望之有芒角。

translations.literal: State Sovereign star—emerging large, color yellow-white, seen with horned rays.
translations.idiomatic: State Sovereign: large yellow-white with horns.

sentences.zh: 見則兵起，國多變，若有水饑，人主惡之，眾庶多疾。

translations.literal: Seen—armies rise, state much change, or flood famine, human lord hates, multitudes much disease.
translations.idiomatic: Seen: armies, change, flood, disease.

sentences.zh: 溫星，色白而大，狀如風動搖，常出四隅。

translations.literal: Warm Star—color white and large, shaped as if wind trembling, regularly emerging four corners.
translations.idiomatic: Warm Star: large white wind-trembling at four corners.

sentences.zh: 出東南，天下有兵，將軍出於野。

translations.literal: Emerging southeast—realm has armies, general emerges in field.
translations.idiomatic: Southeast: armies, general in field.

sentences.zh: 出東北，當有千里暴兵。

translations.literal: Emerging northeast—certainly thousand-li sudden armies.
translations.idiomatic: Northeast: thousand-li sudden armies.

sentences.zh: 出西北，亦如之。

translations.literal: Emerging northwest—also likewise.
translations.idiomatic: Northwest: likewise.

sentences.zh: 出西南，其國兵喪並起，若有大水，人饑。

translations.literal: Emerging southwest—state armies and mourning together, or great flood, people hunger.
translations.idiomatic: Southwest: armies, mourning, flood, hunger.

sentences.zh: 又曰，溫星出東南，為大將軍服屈不能發者。

translations.literal: Also: Warm Star emerging southeast—great general's uniform bent cannot deploy.
translations.idiomatic: Southeast: general unable to deploy.

sentences.zh: 出於東北，暴骸三千里。

translations.literal: Emerging northeast—exposed bones three thousand li.
translations.idiomatic: Northeast: bones three thousand li.

sentences.zh: 出西亦然。

translations.literal: Emerging west also likewise.
translations.idiomatic: West: likewise.

sentences.zh: 凡客星見其分，若留止，即以其色占吉凶。

translations.literal: Generally guest stars seen in their division—if lingering stationary, take omens for fortune and misfortune by their color.
translations.idiomatic: Guest stars in division: omens by color if lingering.

sentences.zh: 星大事大，星小事小。

translations.literal: Large star large affair, small star small affair.
translations.idiomatic: Large star: large affair; small: small.

sentences.zh: 星色黃得地，色白有喪，色青有憂，色黑有死，色赤有兵，各以五色占之，皆不出三年。

translations.literal: Star color yellow gains earth, white has mourning, green has grief, black has death, red has armies—each by five colors take omens, all within three years.
translations.idiomatic: Yellow earth, white mourning, green grief, black death, red armies—within three years.

sentences.zh: 又曰，客星入列宿中外官者，各以其所出部舍官名為其事。

translations.literal: Also: guest star entering lodges inside and outside officials—each by emerged department lodge official name for the affair.
translations.idiomatic: Entering officials: affair by lodge official name.

sentences.zh: 所之者為其謀，其下之國，皆受其禍。

translations.literal: Where it goes is its plot; states below all suffer its calamity.
translations.idiomatic: Where it goes: plot; states below suffer.

sentences.zh: 以所守之舍為其期，以五氣相賊者為其使。

translations.literal: By guarded lodge as term, by five qi mutual conquest as envoy.
translations.idiomatic: Guarded lodge sets term; five qi conquest sets envoy.

sentences.zh: 流星流星，天使也。

translations.literal: Shooting stars—Heaven's envoys.
translations.idiomatic: Shooting stars: Heaven's envoys.

sentences.zh: 自上而降曰流，自下而升曰飛。

translations.literal: Descending from above is shooting; ascending from below is flying.
translations.idiomatic: Descending: shooting; ascending: flying.

sentences.zh: 大者曰奔，奔亦流星也。

translations.literal: Large ones are rushing; rushing is also shooting stars.
translations.idiomatic: Large: rushing—also shooting stars.

sentences.zh: 星大者使大，星小者使小。

translations.literal: Large star large envoy, small star small envoy.
translations.idiomatic: Large star: large envoy; small: small.

sentences.zh: 聲隆隆者，怒之象也。

translations.literal: Sound rumbling—image of anger.
translations.idiomatic: Rumbling: anger.

sentences.zh: 行疾者期速，行遲者期遲。

translations.literal: Fast travel—term fast; slow travel—term slow.
translations.idiomatic: Fast: fast term; slow: slow term.

sentences.zh: 大而無光者，眾人之事。

translations.literal: Large without light—multitudes' affair.
translations.idiomatic: Large without light: multitudes' affair.

sentences.zh: 小而光者，貴人之事。

translations.literal: Small with light—noble persons' affair.
translations.idiomatic: Small with light: nobles' affair.

sentences.zh: 大而光者，其人貴且眾也。

translations.literal: Large with light—the person is noble and multitudinous.
translations.idiomatic: Large with light: noble and many.

sentences.zh: 乍明乍滅者，賊敗成也。

translations.literal: Now bright now extinguished—bandit defeat and accomplishment.
translations.idiomatic: Flickering: bandit defeat and success.

sentences.zh: 前大後小者，恐憂也。

translations.literal: Front large rear small—fear and grief.
translations.idiomatic: Front large rear small: fear and grief.

sentences.zh: 前小後大者，喜事也。

translations.literal: Front small rear large—joyful affair.
translations.idiomatic: Front small rear large: joy.

sentences.zh: 蛇行者，奸事也。

translations.literal: Snake travel—treacherous affair.
translations.idiomatic: Snake travel: treachery.

sentences.zh: 往疾者，往而不返也。

translations.literal: Going fast—going without return.
translations.idiomatic: Fast going: no return.

sentences.zh: 長者，其事長久也。

translations.literal: Long—affair long-lasting.
translations.idiomatic: Long: long-lasting affair.

sentences.zh: 短者，事疾也。

translations.literal: Short—affair urgent.
translations.idiomatic: Short: urgent affair.

sentences.zh: 奔星所墜，其下有兵。

translations.literal: Where rushing star falls—armies below.
translations.idiomatic: Rushing star fall: armies below.

sentences.zh: 無風雲，有流星見，良久間乃入，為大風發屋折木。

translations.literal: No wind or clouds, shooting star seen, long interval then enters—great wind uproots houses and breaks trees.
translations.idiomatic: Shooting star without wind: great wind uproots houses.

sentences.zh: 小流星百數，四面行者，庶人流移之象。

translations.literal: Small shooting stars hundred-number traveling four directions—image of multitudes migrating.
translations.idiomatic: Hundred small shooting stars four directions: mass migration.

sentences.zh: 流星異狀，名占不同。

translations.literal: Shooting stars' anomalous forms—names and omens differ.
translations.idiomatic: Anomalous shooting stars: different names and omens.

sentences.zh: 今略古書及《荊州占》所載云。

translations.literal: Now briefly what ancient books and Jingzhou divination record:
translations.idiomatic: Briefly from ancient books and Jingzhou divination:

sentences.zh: 流星之尾，長二三丈，暉然有光竟天，其色白者，主使也，色赤者，將軍使也。

translations.literal: Shooting star's tail two-three zhang, brilliant with light spanning heaven—white color is envoy; red color is general's envoy.
translations.idiomatic: Tail two-three zhang spanning heaven: white envoy, red general's envoy.

sentences.zh: 流星有光，其色黃白者，從天墜有音，如炬熛火下地，野雉盡鳴，斯天保也。

translations.literal: Shooting star has light yellow-white color, falling from heaven with sound like torch flame to earth, wild pheasants all cry—this is Heaven's protection.
translations.idiomatic: Yellow-white with sound like torch, pheasants cry: Heaven's protection.

sentences.zh: 所墜國安有喜，若水。

translations.literal: Where it falls state is secure with joy, like water.
translations.idiomatic: Where fallen: secure state with joy like water.

sentences.zh: 流星其色青赤，名曰地雁，其所墜者起兵。

translations.literal: Shooting star color green-red called Earth Wild Goose—where it falls armies rise.
translations.idiomatic: Green-red Earth Wild Goose: armies where fallen.

sentences.zh: 流星有光青赤，其長二三丈，名曰天雁，軍之精華也。

translations.literal: Shooting star has light green-red, two-three zhang long called Heaven Wild Goose—army's essence.
translations.idiomatic: Green-red two-three zhang Heaven Wild Goose: army essence.

sentences.zh: 其國起兵，將軍當從星所之。

translations.literal: State raises armies; general should follow star's direction.
translations.idiomatic: State raises armies; general follows star.

sentences.zh: 流星暉然有光，白，長竟天者，人主之星也，主將相軍從星所之。

translations.literal: Shooting star brilliant with light white, tail spanning heaven—human lord's star; lord, chancellor, armies follow star's direction.
translations.idiomatic: White tail spanning heaven: human lord's star; armies follow.

sentences.zh: 凡星如甕者，為發謀起事。

translations.literal: Generally stars like jars—raising plots and affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Jar-like stars: raising plots.

sentences.zh: 大如桃者為使事。

translations.literal: Large like peach—envoy affair.
translations.idiomatic: Peach-large: envoy affair.

sentences.zh: 流星大如缶，其光赤黑，有喙者，名曰梁星，其所墜之鄉有兵，君失地。

translations.literal: Shooting star large like jar or urn, light red-black, has beak—called Beam Star; where fallen township has armies, lord loses land.
translations.idiomatic: Red-black jar with beak Beam Star: armies, lost land.

sentences.zh: 飛星大如缶若甕，後皎然白，前卑後高，此謂頓頑，其所從者多死亡，削邑而不戰。

translations.literal: Flying star large like jar or urn, afterward bright white, front low rear high—this is called Slow Stubborn; many where it follows die, lose fiefs without battle.
translations.idiomatic: Bright white front-low Slow Stubborn: death, lost fiefs without battle.

sentences.zh: 有飛星大如缶若甕，後皎然白，前卑後高，搖頭，乍上乍下，此謂降石，所下民食不足。

translations.literal: Flying star large like jar, afterward bright white front low rear high, shaking head, now up now down—this is called Falling Stone; people below insufficient food.
translations.idiomatic: Falling Stone shaking: insufficient food below.

sentences.zh: 飛星大如缶若甕，後皎然白，星滅後，白者曲環如車輪，此謂解銜。

translations.literal: Flying star large like jar, afterward bright white, star extinguished afterward white curves ring like chariot wheel—this is called Release Bit.
translations.idiomatic: Release Bit wheel ring: people mutually bite for rank and stipend.

sentences.zh: 其國人相斬為爵祿，此謂自相齧食。

translations.literal: People mutually biting and eating—this is called mutual gnawing.
translations.idiomatic: Mutual gnawing for rank and stipend.

sentences.zh: 有飛星大如缶若甕，其後皎然白，長數丈，星滅後，後者化為雲流下，名曰大滑，所下有流血積骨。

translations.literal: Flying star large like jar, afterward bright white, several zhang long, after star extinguished latter becomes cloud flowing down—called Great Slip; below flowing blood piled bones.
translations.idiomatic: Great Slip cloud flow: blood and piled bones.

sentences.zh: 有飛星大如缶若甕，後皎白，縵縵然長可十餘丈而委曲，名曰天刑，一曰天飾，將軍均封疆。

translations.literal: Flying star large like jar, afterward bright white, long ten-plus zhang and curved—called Heaven Punishment, one Heaven Adornment; general equalizes borders.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven Punishment ten-plus zhang curved: general equalizes borders.

sentences.zh: 天狗，狀如大奔星，色黃有聲，其止地類狗，所墜，望之如火光，炎炎衝天，其上銳，其下圓，如數頃田處。

translations.literal: Celestial Dog, shaped like great rushing star, color yellow with sound; where it stops earth class dog; where fallen, seen like fire light, blazing rushing sky, upper sharp lower round, like several qing fields.
translations.idiomatic: Celestial Dog yellow with sound, dog-shaped fall like blazing fields.

sentences.zh: 或曰，星有毛，旁有短彗，下有狗形者。

translations.literal: Or: star has hair, short comet beside, below dog shape.
translations.idiomatic: Or: hair, short comet, dog shape.

sentences.zh: 或曰，星出，其狀赤白有光，下即為天狗。

translations.literal: Or: star emerges red-white with light, below then Celestial Dog.
translations.idiomatic: Red-white light below: Celestial Dog.

sentences.zh: 一曰，流星有光，見人面，墜無音，若有足者，名曰天狗。

translations.literal: One says: shooting star has light, seen human face, falling without sound, as if with feet—called Celestial Dog.
translations.idiomatic: Shooting star with human face, silent, feet: Celestial Dog.

sentences.zh: 其色白，其中黃，黃如遺火狀。

translations.literal: Color white, within yellow, yellow like remnant fire shape.
translations.idiomatic: White outside yellow within like remnant fire.

sentences.zh: 主候兵討賊，見則四方相射，千里破軍殺將。

translations.literal: Governing watching armies attacking bandits; seen—four directions mutually shoot, thousand-li broken armies slain generals.
translations.idiomatic: Watching armies; seen: thousand-li broken armies.

sentences.zh: 或曰，五將鬭，人相食，所往之鄉有流血。

translations.literal: Or: five generals battle, people eat one another, township where gone has flowing blood.
translations.idiomatic: Five generals battle, cannibalism, blood where gone.

sentences.zh: 其君失地，兵大起，國易政，戒守禦。

translations.literal: Its lord loses land, armies rise greatly, state changes government, guard and defend.
translations.idiomatic: Lord loses land, armies, changed government—guard.

sentences.zh: 餘占同前。

translations.literal: Remaining omens same as before.
translations.idiomatic: Remaining omens same as before.

sentences.zh: 營頭，有雲如壞山墮，所謂營頭之星，所墮，其下覆軍，流血千里。

translations.literal: Camp Head—cloud like broken mountain falling, so-called Camp Head star; where fallen below overturned armies, flowing blood thousand li.
translations.idiomatic: Camp Head like falling mountain: overturned armies, blood thousand li.

sentences.zh: 亦曰，流星晝隕名營頭。

translations.literal: Also: shooting star falling by day named Camp Head.
translations.idiomatic: Day falling shooting star: Camp Head.

sentences.zh: 雲氣、瑞氣一曰慶雲，若煙非煙，若雲非雲，鬱鬱紛紛，蕭索輪囷，是謂慶雲，亦曰景雲。

translations.literal: Cloud qi, auspicious qi one is Celebratory Cloud—like smoke not smoke, like cloud not cloud, dense and abundant, desolate and coiled—called Celebratory Cloud, also Luminous Cloud.
translations.idiomatic: Celebratory Cloud: smoke-like, dense—auspicious.

sentences.zh: 此喜氣也，太平之應。

translations.literal: This is joyful qi—response of great peace.
translations.idiomatic: Joyful qi—great peace response.

sentences.zh: 一曰昌光，赤如龍狀。

translations.literal: One is Splendid Light, red like dragon shape.
translations.idiomatic: Splendid Light red like dragon.

sentences.zh: 聖人起，帝受終則見。

translations.literal: Sage rises, Emperor receives end then seen.
translations.idiomatic: Sage rises; Emperor receives end: seen.

sentences.zh: 妖氣一曰虹蜺，日旁氣也。

translations.literal: Baleful qi one is Rainbow—beside sun qi.
translations.idiomatic: Baleful qi one: Rainbow—beside sun.

sentences.zh: 斗之亂精，主惑心，主內淫，主臣謀君，天子詘后妃，顓妻不一。

translations.literal: Dipper's chaotic essence—governing confused heart, internal licentiousness, ministers plotting lord, Son of Heaven humiliates queen consort, exclusive wife not one.
translations.idiomatic: Dipper's chaotic essence: licentiousness, minister plots, humiliated consort.

sentences.zh: 二曰䍧雲，如狗，赤色長尾，為亂君，為兵喪。

translations.literal: Two is Ram Cloud, like dog, red color long tail—for disordered lord, for armies and mourning.
translations.idiomatic: Two: Ram Cloud like red-tailed dog—for disordered lord, armies and mourning.
